descriptionAr: Job Summary In the Clinical AI Devices team, the Software Engineer is primarily responsible for building and maintaining software in the Clinical AI domain, from wrapping deep learning models into containerized medical devices, to integration with other systems. This work spans all of the company's medical devices, across the main radiology modalities: X-Ray, CT, MRI, and Mammography. The focus of the current role is at the interface between product logic and the underlying serving platform, ensuring that requests are correctly validated, routed, and that results are properly assembled and returned. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Participate in the software development process: design, refine, and develop new features, and maintain existing ones. Write code, review teammates' code, and contribute to the testing framework through automated and manual tests. Work with the team lead and product manager to refine requirements. Own features and projects end-to-end, from refinement to production. Flag risks and bugs by keeping the radiologist's workflow in mind. Support service and delivery teams with production issues. Ensure compliance with Quality and Regulatory requirements throughout the development cycle, including technical documentation (e.g. implementation specs), cybersecurity processes, and risk analysis. Collaborate with the team on strategic recommendations and improvements to technology and business. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a related field such as computer science, biomedical engineering or similar (required). Experience (required): at least 5 years of experience in a similar or related relevant role At least 5 years of experience working with Java, with proficiency in Spring Boot (required). Fluent in English (required). Accustomed to CI/CD practice (required). Familiar with test-driven development and testing frameworks like JUnit (required). Experience working with docker, cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, and Kubernetes (required). Experience working with Agentic Coding tools like Claude and Cursor (preferred). Experience working with microservices and distributed systems (preferred). Experience in the MedTech field, e.g. working with DICOM data, AI algorithms, and clinical workflows (preferred). What we value Strong analytical mindset. Not afraid of working inside a strong regulatory framework and disciplined about testing needs. Ability to make well-reasoned trade-offs between velocity and quality, understanding when to work for higher quality and when to optimize for time-to-market. You collaborate openly, support your colleagues, and contribute to shared success. Quality Standards Communicate, cooperate, and consistently function professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. Demonstrate initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercise confidentiality in all areas of performance. Follow all local, regional, and country laws concerning employment. Follow all DeepHealth policies and procedures. Follow data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. Practice universal safety precautions. Promote good public relations on the phone and in person. Adapt and willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. Report to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meals and rest breaks, and maintain satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. Complete job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner. Travel This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%. Working Environment Hybrid, remote-friendly Based in France (we have offices in Paris and Grenoble) or in the Netherlands (we have offices in Rotterdam and Amsterdam) Salary: Dependent upon experience: 60,000-80,000 EURO Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace , Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous croyons en des solutions innovantes et en un environnement inclusif où collaboration et développement professionnel vont de pair. Dans le cadre de programmes cliniques et data à fort enjeu, nous recherchons un(e) Data & Clinical Program Lead capable de faire le lien entre les équipes scientifiques, cliniques et techniques afin d'accélérer l'exploitation des données tout au long du cycle de développement clinique. Vous piloterez des initiatives transverses mêlant Data Science, IA, Data Engineering et Real-World Data, tout en garantissant l'alignement entre les priorités du portefeuille projets et les besoins métier. Missions : Program Leadership & Delivery Piloter des programmes data complexes en support du développement clinique. Définir les feuilles de route, jalons et livrables en cohérence avec les priorités stratégiques. Assurer le suivi des risques, dépendances et échéances sur plusieurs projets simultanément. Préparer et animer les instances de gouvernance ainsi que le reporting auprès des parties prenantes senior. Favoriser la collaboration entre des équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales. Clinical & Data Integration Faire le lien entre les équipes cliniques, scientifiques, Data Science et Data Engineering. Traduire les besoins métiers et les problématiques scientifiques en solutions analytiques concrètes. Accompagner l'intégration des données cliniques, RWD et autres sources de données dans les processus de recherche et développement. Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et la valorisation des données utilisées. AI, Analytics & Innovation Contribuer au déploiement de solutions d'intelligence artificielle et d'analytique avancée. Promouvoir l'utilisation des approches data-driven dans la prise de décision clinique. Participer à l'identification de nouvelles opportunités d'exploitation des données et de l'IA. Veiller à l'adoption des meilleures pratiques en matière d'analyse, de reproductibilité et d'industrialisation. Stakeholder & Portfolio Management Participer à la priorisation des initiatives data et digitales. Accompagner les équipes métiers dans la définition des cas d'usage et de la valeur attendue. Interagir avec des décideurs scientifiques, cliniques et business de haut niveau. Assurer l'alignement entre les différents acteurs dans un environnement matriciel complexe. Requirements À propos de vous Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant. PhD, Master ou diplôme équivalent en Data Science, Biostatistiques, Informatique, Pharmacie ou Sciences de la Vie. Solide expérience en gestion de projets ou programmes Data dans les Life Sciences. Bonne compréhension du développement clinique et de la R&D pharmaceutique. Une expérience des données de vie réelle (RWD/RWE) est un plus. Connaissances en Data Science, IA et environnements de données. Maîtrise ou compréhension de SQL, Python, R ou outils similaires. Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes techniques et métier. Benefits Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Ce qui nous distingue : Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur. Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient. Exceller avec bienveillance Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An Overview of this role As a Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team,  you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. You’ll also support the company-level reporting and GTM performance views that executives use to run the business, covering consumption, ARR, and first orders. What you’ll do Embed yourself with business teams to become a trusted partner supporting insight generation and strategic decision making across GTM. Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover behavioral trends, long-term patterns, and the key drivers and levers behind business performance, and communicate their impact clearly to non-technical audiences. Build and productionize machine learning models - such as propensity, product-qualified lead (PQL) scoring, churn, and expansion models - including training, validation, testing, and feature engineering, using MLOps practices and tooling (CI/CD for ML pipelines, model registries, automated retraining, and monitoring) to move work reliably from notebook to production Design, run, and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experiments) on onboarding, pricing and packaging, and upgrade flows, and measure their impact on activation, conversion, and retention Build and operationalize agentic workflows for analysis, modeling, and pipeline automation, with evaluation and monitoring that keep agent-generated insights accurate, traceable, and trustworthy. Contribute to GitLab’s Semantic Layer enabling stakeholders and agents to self-serve metrics using trusts and tested sources. Write production-grade Python and SQL that meets internal standards for style, maintainability, and performance in a high-scale database environment; maintain and advocate for these standards through code review What you’ll bring 3-5 years of professional experience in GTM analytics, data science, or a similar technical role Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, measurable questions and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders. Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, classification, clustering, and survival analysis Deep, hands-on understanding of SQL in cloud data warehouses (like Snowflake SQL), including working with product usage and event data, and in business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar) Experience using Python for statistical modeling, machine learning, and production data science. With hands-on experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, and related libraries such as LightGBM and XGBoost Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability. Experience working in a B2C company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization About the Team The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab’s Company wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. We work across the business on metrics including First Orders, pipeline, CRR, ARR, and other key indicators, helping leaders make informed decisions and teams understand how their work contributes to GitLab’s growth. How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off  Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave   Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guide

descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to own model delivery. Every model we ship, whether we trained it or brought it in from a partner, has to be selected on evaluation criteria, integrated and routed across the product stack, and adhere to regulatory requirements; released to customer environments ready for general availability. That now happens on a monthly cadence, with several model evaluations a week, and each release goes out to our platform partners. This is a standing program, with one owner from model candidate to GA. You will join Product Engineering Program Management and work across modeling, evaluation, inference serving, engineering, customer delivery. At Cohere, Technical Program Managers are the operational owners of cross-functional work. The best of them are precise at the tactical level and useful at the strategic one: organized, execution-oriented, pragmatic, and able to change pace when the program does. As a Technical Program Manager, you will: Own the path from model candidate to general availability for first-party and third-party models, on a monthly cadence. Build one release process across modeling, evaluation, product integration, and customer delivery, with an owner, exit criteria, and lead time for each stage. Run a delivery-readiness gate that has to pass before general availability: packaging, signed images and digests, documentation, serving configuration, test coverage, and parity across Platform, Model Vault, and private deployments. Work with Safety and Legal to build regulatory checkpoints into the model release pipeline, including EU AI Act systemic-risk obligations. Program manage the recurring compliance calendar post launch: the yearly review of our frontier framework, serious-incident reporting deadlines, and access for external evaluators. Stand up a model registry the field, partner teams and regulators can answer from, covering name, route, alias, checkpoint, sizing, serving configuration, and where each model is available. Run intake for new models, keep the pipeline visible, and drive the selection decision to the right owner by a date, with a decision log of which models enter the lineup. Sequence deprecation and partner notices on a calendar agreed with customer and partner teams. Make the monthly model lineup change a routine step in North, including routing and availability, and feed model readiness into the product release train. Build the mechanisms that make the cadence repeatable: templates, the registry, automation, and retros that change the system. Write the status, the decision, and the external notice so executives, engineers, and partners are working from the same answer. You may be a good fit if you: Have at least 8 years as an Engineering or Technical Program Manager, including ownership of repeatable launches with readiness checklists, go/no-go gates, and rollback criteria that teams actually used. Can discuss model serving and deployment at a working level: GPU sizing, tensor parallelism, quantization, speculative decoding, containers, Kubernetes and Helm, image signing, and air-gapped or private deployment. Enough to spot conflicting answers and know who decides. Drive open questions (name, alias, default, sizing) to the owner who should decide them, by a date, and then publish the answer. Influence without authority across research, engineering, product, and the field. Write clearly for executives, engineers, and external partners, including customer and partner notices. Are comfortable at a high cadence, with shifting priorities and overlapping launches. Can read evaluation results and a cost-versus-performance tradeoff, and can tell when a benchmark does not answer the product question. Helpful, and not required: Launch experience at a model provider or an AI platform. Familiarity with the ML lifecycle: evaluations, checkpoints, provenance, and serving stacks such as vLLM. Experience running launches under regulation or an AI management standard, such as the EU AI Act or ISO 42001. Experience with model routing, AI gateways, or agent platforms. Enterprise software delivery to regulated customers. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates based in the US. The Opportunity: Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack. The Databases team owns the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics , Loki for logs , Tempo for traces , and Pyroscope for profiles . Our databases are OSS projects that we also offer as a Cloud service supporting Grafana Cloud, and as an on-premise solution. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and running on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (GCP, Azure, AWS). We also have engineers working on Prometheus , Grafana Alloy , Mimir proxies , and OpenTelemetry. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. Our tech stack is mostly made up of services written in Go, running on multiple Kubernetes clusters that leverage Cloud object storage. We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What You’ll Be Doing: Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability. Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives. Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve. Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers. Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope. Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running. Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions, and collaborate with the team. Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system. As we are remote-first and our engineering organisation is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must. What Makes You a Great Fit: You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action. You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs . Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively. Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must. Requirements: Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, C, C++, Rust or similar then that translates well. Some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements and brainstorming ideas, all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way. Some experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud or some experience with systems engineering. Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others. Bonus Points For: Experience writing low level code for databases, storage layers, or query engines. Experience working with Kubernetes. Been a user of Grafana and/or Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools in hobby/homelab projects). Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems, or a desire to learn. These systems power the logs, analytics, and alerts that give customers near real-time visibility into the security, reliability, and performance of their Internet properties. Develop data delivery pipelines that route data from Cloudflare’s global network to customer destinations. Build and scale GraphQL APIs, log delivery integrations, and near real-time alerting products. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand their data needs and design pragmatic solutions. Evaluate technologies and contribute to the next generation of Cloudflare’s data platform. Participate in an on-call rotation for the production systems owned by your team. Strong Go programming skills, or substantial systems programming experience (Rust, C++) with the ability to become productive in Go quickly. Experience building and operating production services, including deployment, monitoring, capacity planning, incident response, and debugging. A solid understanding of distributed-systems concepts, including concurrency, consistency, fault tolerance, partitioning, and data integrity. Experience with high-throughput or low-latency data processing. Hands-on experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, including monitoring high-cardinality workloads. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, particularly for complex production problems. Clear communication and an ability to collaborate across engineering and product teams. Demonstrated depth in at least one of the following areas: Database systems: SQL, analytical databases, database internals, query optimisation, performance tuning, or operating large database clusters. Data delivery and retrieval: Streaming systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, API development, or customer-facing data integrations. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C.; Toronto, Canada About the role Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet. As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable and flexible platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities. Responsibilities Design scalable and resilient systems that can keep up with company growth. Work with application teams to understand their needs and challenges, and help them choose the best way to architect their systems to run well in our Kubernetes environment. Harden the platform against security threats, noisy neighbours, and accidents. Improve the efficiency of our use of resources such as CPU, memory, bandwidth, and storage. Help respond to, resolve, and prevent incidents impacting the platform or our users. Contribute back to the open source community. Some of our favorite open source projects include: Envoy, Contour, Consul, etcd, cdk8s, Cloudprober, Calico, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, and more. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Experience managing production Kubernetes clusters. Experience operating systems on-premise at scale in roles such as SRE, systems design or architecture. Excellent debugging skills in a Linux environment. Knowledge of how container runtimes work inside of Linux (isolation, storage, and networking). A firm grasp of IP networking including routing and iptables/nftables. Ability to work with codebases in Go, TypeScript, and Bash/shell. The ability to break down complex problems into smaller pieces, provide options, talk through trade-offs, build consensus, and drive the effort to solve the problem. Bonus Points Familiarity with building platforms across multiple zones and regions as the foundation for other teams to build distributed highly-available applications. Experience with configuration management frameworks such as SaltStack or Ansible. Experience with continuous deployment tooling like ArgoCD and Argo Rollouts. Operational/administrator experience with etcd, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, CNIs, ClusterAPI, Envoy, and/or Contour. Experience as a user of Prometheus, Elasticsearch/Kibana, Vault, Redis, and/or Consul. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000 For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000 For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000 For Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000 For Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000 For Toronto, Canada based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000 Applications will be accepted until December 25, 2026. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! descriptionAr: About the Team The ClickPipes team builds the services that power data ingestion into ClickHouse Cloud. As a primary entry point for customers’ data, ClickPipes is critical to product adoption and the company’s growth. We work at petabyte scale, solving challenges in distributed systems, fault tolerance, and high-throughput ingestion. You’ll help make these pipelines performant, reliable, and easy to operate, with ownership of technical decisions and the platform as a whole. You can find some of the team’s recent work highlighted in our blog: GCP Pub/Sub connector for ClickPipes is now in Private Preview Terraform & OpenAPI for ClickPipes is now Generally Available Unordered mode for GCS ClickPipes is now available We’re looking for backend engineers with experience in data-intensive systems who enjoy working across technologies. You’ll collaborate with engineering and product partners and drive projects from design through production. What will you do? Build and evolve integrations with streaming platforms and object storage, including Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage. Continuously improve our systems based on operational metrics, customer feedback, and evolving business requirements. Drive technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions that impact our platform's scalability and resilience. Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and respond to production incidents. About you: 5+ years of software development experience building and operating distributed systems. Strong knowledge of Go and its ecosystem. Experience designing systems for scalability and fault tolerance, with an understanding of concurrency, consistency, and failure recovery. Understanding of cloud-native architecture and practical experience with at least one major cloud provider. Experience diagnosing and resolving production issues in distributed systems. Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate across engineering and product teams. Experience with data ingestion pipelines, streaming platforms, or object storage is a plus. Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Equal Opportunity & Privacy ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a senior researcher in GitLab's Threat Research group, you'll turn emerging security threats into protection for GitLab customers. You'll lead your own research projects, taking ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploying it, and analyzing the results. You'll also keep the detection systems you build running in production. Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. We build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster. This is a full-stack research role: you'll combine an adversarial mindset with the software engineering skills to build and operate the systems behind your work. What you’ll do Lead your own research projects, from the first idea to the published result. Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems. Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools. Analyze supply chain incidents and events. Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection. Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work. Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories. Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences. What you’ll bring Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with published findings such as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records, responsible disclosures, blog posts, or talks. Experience researching AI agents, large language model (LLM) applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and using AI in real work through LLM application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs). The ability to build systems and assess how to break them, with strong Go or Python skills and practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and maintainable code. Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud. An understanding of package ecosystems and supply chain attacks, informed by current security and AI industry trends. The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward while balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes. Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience. Helpful but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience, infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu, databases or data pipelines at scale, and reverse engineering. You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough. You don't have to match every listed requirement exactly to be considered. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. About the team The Threat Research group at GitLab researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database , which powers GitLab's dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical RCE in Serena , a popular MCP coding agent. More on the Security Labs blog .     Remote-Global How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off  Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave   Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. descriptionAr: About PostHog PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including: A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics , replay vision , AI observability , and error tracking PostHog MCP for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data Data warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights. We are: Product-led . More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit. Default alive . Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey. We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible . Things we care about Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook . Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions. Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions . Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed. Shipping fast: Why not now? We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end. Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days , and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had. Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun. Who we're looking for We’re looking for people (in the US/Canada - GMT -8 to GMT -6) that like deep ownership of production systems, people that are not afraid of working with stateful infrastructure and love working in AWS, VMs, automation, and making messy systems reliable. In general we seek SRE’s who are: Enthusiastic drivers. We need proactive people that can fully own projects and get them done, and know to get help when needed. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source. You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab.com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team. Some examples of our projects: A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com What you’ll do Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls. Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration. Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives. Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features. Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab.com Production team. Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team. What you’ll bring Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions. Strong experience with Linux systems administration, scripting, Git, and continuous integration and continuous delivery in production or customer environments, with the ability to investigate issues at both the infrastructure and application levels. Ability to mentor teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions, case reviews, and cross-team collaboration. Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to turn customer feedback into product fixes, feature improvements, and roadmap priorities. Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless computing, and an understanding of how different GitLab implementations operate and affect customers. Demonstrated ability to learn, collaborate across teams, and apply transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles. Fluent Korean language skills (required) About the team We're a globally distributed group of Support Engineers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. We work asynchronously and stay connected through pairing sessions, one-on-one meetings, coffee chats, and Slack. We structure our shifts to support our personal lives while meeting customer needs. Thanks to GitLab’s transparency value, you can see what we are working on and how we operate on our Support Team page . How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off  Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave   Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification.

descriptionAr: Perplexity is revolutionizing how companies get work done, from the Fortune 500 to one-person ecommerce shops. We are looking for a Customer Marketing Manager to find the best of those stories and tell them well. This is a 0>1 role with executive exposure from day one. You'll set the strategy for and build our customer storytelling and advocacy program, working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Comms, Brand, and Legal. You'll run the interviews and write most of the stories yourself. If you have a reporter's instinct for a good story and like building the playbook rather than following one, this role is for you. RESPONSIBILITIES Find the stories. Partner with Sales and dig into data to spot customers getting real results with Perplexity, and decide which stories to invest in. Tell them well. Interview customers, from global brand executives to solo founders, and write stories that are specific, true, and worth reading or watching. Cover the full range of our customers. Build a portfolio across enterprise, startups, small businesses, and solo operators, balancing a few deep stories with scaled programs. Make every story travel. Turn each story into case studies, films, quotes, social posts, event talks, and sales assets, and bring customer voices into launches, press, and keynotes. Build an advocacy program. Recruit and look after customer advocates for references, speaking, media, and advisory groups, and build the proof library Sales relies on. Build the operating system. Own the ops behind the program, including an internal system that surfaces potential stories from Sales, Customer Success, Support, and product usage, plus intake, prioritization, production, and approvals, so stories move quickly without lowering the bar. Measure what they influence. QUALIFICATIONS 7+ years in customer marketing, customer advocacy, content, journalism, or product marketing, ideally at a high-growth B2B or AI technology company. Strong command of written and spoken language, and a real instinct for people: what they care about, what they mean, and how to draw out their story. Track record building and leading customer story and advocacy programs, including high-profile stories. Equally credible with Fortune 500 executives and founders who have no marketing team. Comfortable with technical products and able to explain them in plain language. Works across teams without formal authority, thrives in ambiguity, and operates with urgency. NICE TO HAVE You've led marketing at a startup or small business. You use AI tools in your own work, and you use Perplexity regularly.

descriptionAr: About the team The Control Plane Platform team is building the shared foundation that every product in ClickHouse Cloud is built and shipped on. We give ClickHouse engineering teams one place to own and deploy their product, remove the overhead of rebuilding common plumbing, and keep the customer experience consistent as the number of integrating teams grows. The team owns API gateways and API standards, shared platform services, deployment and infrastructure patterns, testing and CI, local developer experience and Control Plane observability. About the role We’re looking for a platform software engineer that will work on developing the shared services and core of the platform. This is a high-impact, technical role at the center of our Cloud product, combining technical direction, scalability mindset, and operational ownership while maintaining the reliability customers expect. You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering teams across ClickHouse. This role goes beyond engineering. As part of the platform team, you’ll help shape how new products and teams will integrate and deploy their applications in ClickHouse Cloud. What You'll Do Build and evolve the core platform surface: shared platform services (event bus, notifications, feature flags, websockets, audit records, Customer Data Platform), internal tools, CI and testing, local developer experience, and the software factory. Build the Customer Data Platform that captures customer events from our web applications and APIs, and make that data reliably available to the teams and systems that depend on it. Own the integration points that let teams host and ship their code in our monorepo, so each team can own and deploy its product without rebuilding common plumbing. Treat integrating teams as your customers, and measure success by their delivery velocity and their adoption of the platform. Raise the bar on architecture and design through thoughtful reviews of designs and code, including those of other senior engineers. Land cross-cutting migrations, deprecations, and contract changes across teams without stalling product delivery. Dive into the design and code of complex areas: gateway routing, spec-driven code generation, event delivery semantics and idempotency, and multi-region rollout safety. Define and drive API standards across the platform so the customer experience stays consistent as the number of integrating teams grows. Build and improve Control Plane observability, and take part in incident response and investigation to improve the platform's reliability. Systematize support, reduce toil, and build self-serve and auto-healing capabilities: golden-path templates and generators, and documentation that gets a new team integrated in days rather than weeks. Work alongside software engineers and DevOps/Infra engineers who build and maintain the platform's infrastructure. Help shape the platform vision and turn it into a roadmap. Sequence bets for business impact, ship fast with tight feedback loops, and write the RFCs that build cross-org consensus before big changes land. What you bring 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years developing internal and external platforms. Experience developing internal tools and infrastructure for other engineering teams, such as service catalogs, golden-path templates, and self-service app scaffolding. Experience with large TypeScript/Node monorepos and the developer-experience problems that come with them: CI scale and flakiness, build and test times, local development environments, and code generation from specs. Experience building scalable, highly available, and secure cloud infrastructure in AWS (EKS, SQS, DocumentDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, Lambda), with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm) and progressive delivery (Argo Rollouts or similar). Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), including patterns for hosting many independently deployed applications in a shared cluster. Experience building event-driven systems (queues, event buses, notification pipelines) and a solid grasp of delivery guarantees, ordering, retries, and idempotency. A track record of decomposing a monolith into independently deployable services without stalling product delivery. Technical credibility to engage deeply in architecture discussions and incident investigations. Sound execution judgment across ambiguity, parallel workstreams, risk, and long-term system health. Strong written communication, including authoring RFCs and design docs that drive alignment across teams. Nice to have Familiarity with API platform work: OpenAPI-driven contracts, API gateways, and the shared concerns they centralize (authentication, RBAC, rate limiting, versioning, and deprecation). Designed and implemented strategies for load balancing, auto-scaling, disaster recovery, and failover in cloud environments. Experience building CI/CD at scale. Proficiency with frontend frameworks (React). Experience making APIs consumable by AI agents: MCP servers, CLIs, or skills generated from API specs. Experience building or operating customer event tracking or analytics pipelines. Experience with ClickHouse. Previous experience developing analytics or data-intensive applications. Why This Role Shape how every feature team in ClickHouse Cloud develops, ships, and integrates with the others. Operate with ownership, autonomy, and speed while keeping the company lean. descriptionAr: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About the Role: An AI agent is only as useful as what it knows about your company. For many of the world's leading companies, that knowledge lives in Notion. The AI Knowledge & Capabilities team makes sure every agent working in Notion – built by Notion, by customers, or by other AI companies – finds the right answer, quickly and at a cost that makes sense. We own the systems that make this work: search, knowledge, and memory. We also own the agent harness – the tools, context, and model choices that turn a model into a working agent. We decide what to build using evals, customer feedback, and product judgment. Our work reaches users directly, and other AI teams at Notion build on it. We recently shipped Memories, so Notion AI, Custom Agents, and agents connected through MCP can learn and remember across platforms. We also shipped Auto, a model router that delivers frontier quality at 90% lower cost. Next, we're bringing memory, search, and the harness together into one system. Nobody has figured out how to package that yet – we want any company to get a great knowledge system for its agents with a click or a few questions. You will be a technical leader for the team. You'll set direction across search, knowledge, and the harness, starting hands-on with making agents better and cheaper, and help define how Notion measures AI quality. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. What You'll Achieve: Set technical direction for search, knowledge, and the agent harness – make the architecture calls, run design reviews, and decide what the team builds next. Make Notion's agents better, faster, and cheaper – starting with the harness: which tools an agent can call, what context it gets, and which model handles each request. Lead how we measure agent quality – evolve the metrics and evals that reflect real usage, and use them to choose what ships. Turn company data into answers agents can use – build agentic search and memory that give every agent the context it needs, at the right latency and cost. Work closely with research – partner with Notion's model research team on evals, model choice, and models trained for agentic work, and get what works into production. You'll also work with search platform and AI product teams on work that spans teams. Grow the team – mentor engineers, review designs, and develop the next tech leads. descriptionAr: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About the Role: Trust is essential to how organizations choose and use Notion. As Head of Global Security Assurance, you will build and lead a global, customer-facing pillar of our GRCP function. Your team will help customers understand and trust how Notion protects their data, meets security and compliance expectations, and approaches privacy across our products and services. You will lead regional customer assurance leaders and partner closely with Privacy, GRC and Security leadership to establish a clear, scalable model for customer trust. You’ll work directly with customers and go-to-market teams on complex security and privacy questions, while turning what you learn into better products, stronger processes and more transparent communications. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set a global strategy, empower experienced regional experts and navigate the details when it matters most. This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. What You'll Achieve: Lead global customer trust. Set the strategy, priorities and operating model for customer security assurance and customer-facing privacy engagement across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. Balance consistent global standards with regional customer and regulatory needs. Build and grow the team. Lead, coach and develop regional assurance leaders and other specialists. Give them the autonomy, context and executive access to represent Notion confidently with customers; plan coverage, capacity and hiring as demand grows. Earn customer confidence. Serve as a senior security and privacy counterpart for strategic and regulated customers. Lead complex due diligence, executive conversations and escalations, and help teams navigate procurement, renewals and expansion without overstating our controls or commitments. Scale assurance operations. Establish clear intake, prioritization, handoffs and escalation paths for questionnaires, customer calls, security reviews and other requests. Partner with Legal on contractual security and privacy terms, and with subject-matter owners on accurate, timely responses. Make trust understandable. Own the customer assurance content strategy, including the Trust Center, evidence-sharing practices, reusable response libraries, playbooks and go-to-market enablement. Keep materials accurate, consistent and appropriate for the audience. Connect privacy to customer trust. Partner with Privacy and Legal leaders to translate privacy practices, data handling, AI and subprocessor questions into clear customer-facing guidance. Define decision rights and route legal interpretations, privacy assessments and commitments to their accountable owners. Strengthen regional assurance. Work with regional leaders and the compliance team on customer and market requirements, including relevant assessments such as K-FSI, ISMAP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and BSI C5. Coordinate customer-facing and regional engagement while partnering with compliance owners on controls, evidence and audits. Turn customer feedback into action. Identify recurring security, privacy and product gaps; bring customer impact and regional context to Product, Engineering, Security and leadership; and track decisions and follow-through. Support trust through incidents. Partner with incident command, Security, Privacy, Legal and Communications on accurate, timely customer responses and escalations. Build reusable processes that help the team respond consistently while respecting established incident ownership. Improve how the work scales. Use thoughtful automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve intake, knowledge reuse and reporting, with human review, access controls and clear accountability. Track request volume, responsiveness, quality, customer impact and capacity; use the results to guide investment. Skills You'll Need to Bring: Experience leading and developing security assurance, customer trust, privacy, GRC or related teams, including experienced individual contributors and regional leaders. Experience serving enterprise customers in security or privacy due diligence, including customer conversations, questionnaires, contract security reviews and complex escalations. Ability to translate cloud security architecture, security controls, audit evidence and privacy practices into clear, accurate language for technical and executive audiences. Working knowledge of security assurance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and the ability to navigate regional or industry-specific requirements with specialists. Experience partnering with Privacy and Legal on customer data protection questions, contractual commitments and escalation. Sound judgment about when to involve legal, technical and regulatory subject-matter experts. descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role As a Solutions Consultant at Ramp, you will play a crucial role in establishing and nurturing partnerships with potential customers. This involves building trust and confidence through expert demonstrations of Ramp's products and a deep understanding of our prospects' needs. Collaborating closely with Account Executives, Customer Success, and Account Management teams, you will prioritize and develop financial solutions for Ramp's key customers, ensuring that the product aligns with their evolving requirements. Acting as technical and financial experts, you will design integrated solutions, provide strategic advice to prospects, and facilitate communication between internal technical teams and prospects. Solutions Consultants drive customer success from deal evaluation to product activation, influencing product development to continually enhance Ramp's value proposition. This role requires strong technical skills, alongside strong presentation and value selling skills. What You’ll Do Collaborate with Ramp Account Executives to showcase technical accounting features and benefits through customized product demos, workflow illustrations, and promoting Ramp’s value proposition Develop tailored product solutions based on a deep understanding of integration and configuration options, ensuring effective alignment with customer needs Partner with Sales, Product and Partners to advocate for integration development in-line with customer needs Support Sales and Post-Sales teams in executing advanced technical and accounting implementations for Ramp Evaluate customer requirements for new opportunities, determining Ramp's suitability through use-case analysis, ROI assessments, and technical evaluations during customer discovery Work alongside Product, Product Marketing, and Product Operations to create and maintain technical assets and an internal knowledge base of customer use cases and best practices What You’ll Need 2+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or similar customer-facing roles, focusing on implementing business SaaS solutions and utilizing APIs, preferably within the financial sector Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, finance, accounting or related field Proficiency in IdP, HRIS, and/or ERP solutions Expertise in accounting systems, controllership needs, and finance/accounting workflows Exceptional organizational, project management, and time management abilities Strong skills in engineering, system design, and technical specification writing Proactive mindset, adaptability, and comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment For candidates located in NYC or SF, the pay range for this role is $128,000 - $176,000. For remote candidates located in all other locations, the pay range for this role is $115,000-$159,000. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. You will lead complex, multi-year platform deals across Cloudflare’s SASE/Zero Trust, Application Security, Developer Platform, and Network/CDN portfolio—helping CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs consolidate legacy point products onto one global intelligent network. Responsibilities Own Regional Enterprise Accounts: Build and execute multi-threaded account plans to acquire new logos and expand strategic enterprise agreements across large, complex organizations. Strategic Revenue Leadership: Develop and execute account plans to meet and exceed revenue goals by structuring enterprise-grade platform partnerships within key accounts. Sell Platform Consolidation to the C-Suite: Partner with CIOs, CISOs, and VP-level architecture leaders to displace incumbent firewall, VPN, MPLS, and CDN vendors with Cloudflare’s unified connectivity cloud. Run Disciplined Deal Execution: Manage accurate forecasting and pipeline progression using MEDDPICC (or comparable enterprise frameworks), leveraging executive sponsors, Solutions Engineers, and channel/GSI partners. Shape Product & Field Strategy: Feed customer architecture requirements directly back to Product Management and leadership to accelerate enterprise adoption. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 8+ years of B2B enterprise technology sales experience with a verified track record of consistently exceeding $1.5M+ annual quota on complex, multi-year software, cloud, or cybersecurity deals. Deep understanding of enterprise cloud platforms, network security, and modern IT architecture. Proven capability to align solutions with customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and enterprise business models mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments. Proven ability to navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees (Security, Networking, Infrastructure, AppDev, and Procurement) and close seven-figure agreements. Experience co-selling alongside strategic channel partners, VARs, and global systems integrators. Willingness to travel regionally within the Michigan territory to build executive customer relationships. Proficiency with enterprise sales tools and methodologies (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, MEDDPICC, or similar frameworks). Relevant professional experience in technology sales or enterprise consulting; advanced degrees or continuous technical learning are welcomed. Willingness to travel as needed to foster strong customer and internal team relationships. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.  Estimated annual salary of $340,000- $360,000 (base/variable) with uncapped commissions. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.
