descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity  Grafana Labs is looking for an  Enterprise Account Executive, Acquisition based in Sweden who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across the Nordics . You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before. What You’ll Be Doing Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals Outbound prospecting into net-new customers Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations) Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests What Makes You a Great Fit: 5+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer) Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually Fluent in English and Swedish (both written and spoken)  Bonus Points For:  Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage Experience using Salesforce Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal Fluency in Danish and/or Norwegian (both written and spoken) Compensation & Rewards   In Sweden, the OTE compensation range for this role is SEK 2,016,000 - SEK 2,546,000.  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.  *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture -  As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.  Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the DataViz squad, owning its performance, delivery and customer outcomes. You’ll help shape how these capabilities enable users to understand their data and take action. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What You’ll Be Doing: Be accountable for the performance of a distributed engineering squad: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability. Own hiring and team planning, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs. Lead discovery with your squad: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities. Develop an informed point of view on product direction with Product, Design and senior engineers. Keep priorities explicit, assess new requests against business impact and capacity, and make clear decisions about what to stop or defer, balancing customer and community needs with long-term platform investments and operational demands. Own delivery from discovery through rollout and measurement. Help the squad scope small, valuable increments, learn through short feedback loops and complete the most important work. Build the team’s ability to surface risks early and adapt plans as evidence and priorities change. Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through. Improve how the squad plans, makes decisions and delivers, including limits on work in progress. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work. Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the squad’s visualisations, rendering libraries, panel configuration and interactions. Balance user experience, accessibility, performance, reliability and security with the evolution of shared foundations and the plugin ecosystem. Build shared ownership so engineers recognise delivery risks, help one another and rally around the highest-priority outcomes. Coach the squad to make decisions together and shift effort across projects when needed. Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work. Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes. Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions. Agency, creativity, low ego: fix what's broken without being asked, ask questions that are not yet fashionable, and let ideas win on evidence. Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly. We are looking for individuals with a strong background in technical sales or systems engineering who can effectively communicate complex concepts to both technical and executive audiences. Key Qualifications: Must be fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish. 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Sales, Solutions/Systems Engineering, or a related field. Active adoption of the use of AI tools in professional day to day workflows and knowledge on AI security concepts relevant to enterprise customers:  Securing employee AI tool usage,  Governing AI application access, and understanding the data leakage risks posed by generative AI tools Demonstrated experience presenting technical solutions and communicating the value of network and security transformation to senior-level executives. Business Development sits at the front of this motion, where technical curiosity turns into executive engagement, and early product signals become enterprise-wide deployments. About the Role This role is designed as a launchpad for future sellers at OpenAI. This is a highly strategic role with significant exposure to enterprise sales, product, and customer strategy. You’ll develop core skills in discovery, stakeholder mapping, deal shaping, and executive communication while building a deep understanding of how leading companies adopt AI. We are looking for individuals with 2-4+ years of professional experience as a SDR or BDR, who are motivated to grow into world-class enterprise sellers over time. While many individuals in this role go on to become Account Directors or take on broader GTM roles, progression is based on performance and business needs rather than a fixed timeline. For the right person, this is one of the most accelerated paths to break into sales at OpenAI and build a long-term career in AI go-to-market. In this role, you will identify, shape, and advance complex enterprise opportunities by turning product usage, pilots, and inbound demand into qualified, high-conviction enterprise opportunities for our Large Enterprise and Strategic Accounts teams. This role is based in our Dublin, Ireland office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Fluency in English and German is required for this role. In this role, you will: Partner with Account Directors on Enterprise account strategy, multi-threading, and deal progression Design and execute targeted outbound strategies using industry context, stakeholder mapping, and product signal to break into priority accounts Lead high-quality discovery to uncover business priorities, map stakeholders, and assess enterprise readiness Contribute to pipeline reviews by sharing outbound activity, account insights, and early competitive signals. Build and iterate on AI-enabled GTM workflows (GPTs/agents) to scale prospecting and qualification You may thrive in this role if you: Have 2-4 years of relevant experience in enterprise sales, with some of that time focused on outbound pipeline generation Enterprise segment experience, pitching to technical personas Have a track record of consistently hitting and exceeding ambitious targets in enterprise or strategic sales environments (share your attainment on your CV!) We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote opportunity and we're interested in candidates based in the US or Canada. Residents of Quebec are not eligible for this role. Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, Grafana Data Source Plugins The Opportunity: As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer in the Grafana Data Source Plugins squad, you will take a leading role in developing and enhancing a diverse portfolio of data source plugins that retrieve the data powering Grafana dashboards used by teams worldwide.  Our team focuses on continuously improving data source plugins, ensuring seamless experience for human and agent users alike. A key aspect of this role is guaranteeing the smooth operation and reliability of our plugins in the Grafana Cloud, helping us deliver on our commitment to world-class observability tools.  What You’ll Be Doing:  Some data source plugins we own:  Prometheus, Loki, Infinity, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS Cloudwatch, and Clickhouse.  The full catalog is listed here . A typical “day in the life” could include:  Building or improving Grafana plugins to integrate third party services or databases into Grafana  Supporting the operations and reliability of our plugins in Grafana Cloud Coming up with suggestions for process improvements Integrating data sources with agentic workflows such as Grafana Assistant Providing technical support in customer escalations  Working closely with the rest of the Grafana Division What Makes You a Great Fit: You know how to transform ideas into working code, you are able to design a solution, get feedback and deliver large projects. You are a self-driven individual who understands the power of feedback loops in making roadmap decisions and driving our product forward. You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action, and willing to take on any challenge You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs. You are an excellent communicator and you enjoy collaboration You are comfortable working in a remote-first company Requirements: Solid experience with Golang & Typescript Experience with Kubernetes & microservices Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others Experience participating in an on-call rotation and performing operations/SRE tasks Bonus Points For: You have been a user of Grafana and Grafana Data Sources You have expertise in one of the underlying databases we support You have strong experience working with a Product Manager or external stakeholders In the United States, the Base compensation range for this role is USD $ 167,143 - $200,572 .  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here . #LI-Remote #LI-Remote *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture -  As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.  Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment id

descriptionAr: You know SaaS. You like helping people get it right. And you'd rather have a real conversation than a hard sell. Do you speak German natively and want to help organisations get the most from a world-class SaaS platform? Then this might be the role you're looking for. Join a lean-by-design, globally recognised B2B SaaS company as the German-speaking specialist for our DACH+ markets. No cold calling, no quotas — just meaningful conversations that help interested people discover how our software makes their work easier, then supporting them brilliantly once they're on board. You won't be opening the market alone. Our marketing team already brings in German-speaking interest, and our experienced English-speaking sales colleagues handle these leads well. Your edge is simple and valuable: when a German-speaking prospect wants a demo auf Deutsch , or a new client wants onboarding and support in their own language, you're the person who makes that feel effortless — gründlich, verlässlich und auf den Punkt. Join our Rebel Alliance We're a diverse, remote crew that takes the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll be a valued member of our global Client Success team, well supported with the tools, knowledge and people you need to do excellent work. In time you'll learn to work across teams and draw on our collective expertise — and you'll have real backing at every turn to grow into a confident product expert. What you'll do Run German-language demos for warm, interested leads — clearly and confidently Become a product expert (with our support) and answer client and prospect questions accurately Onboard and support clients in German and/or English, setting them up for success from day one Provide responsive, thoughtful support in either German or English Test scenarios carefully so your answers are technically correct, not guessed Report recurring issues to help us improve the product Build trust through honesty, empathy and reliability What you bring (essentials) Native-level German (C2) and strong business English Minimum 3 years SaaS experience in support, onboarding, implementation or technical pre-sales Real technical aptitude. Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, staging vs production, dev console and database queries are familiar — you needn't be a developer, but you should be genuinely comfortable around them and quick to learn the product's technical side A confident communicator, written and spoken, who listens well Comfortable discussing product value and guiding decisions — without the hard sell Highly organised and process-driven; at home in a remote, tool-rich setup Based in EMEA, ideally within DACH or close business-hours overlap (UTC+1/+2) Reliable internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace Nice to have Familiarity with awards, grants, recognition or programme-management workflows Experience supporting clients across both German and English The short version If you're technically sharp, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to be the German-speaking specialist our DACH+ clients rely on, we'd love to hear from you. Komm an Bord!

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Location: Melbourne About the Department The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine - winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle. The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes. About This Role We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Account Executive to join our Enterprise Field Sales team, based in Melbourne. This is a high-agency, hunter-led enterprise sales role focused on winning new business and expanding Cloudflare’s presence across target accounts and other priority enterprise accounts in Melbourne and Victoria. You will be responsible for building and progressing strategic opportunities in complex organisations where access is hard-won, decision-making is distributed, and the sales cycle requires sustained executive engagement, internal alignment, and disciplined execution. The Opportunity  The Solutions Engineering team are the customer facing product experts. The team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure that they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Solutions Engineering team is one of the primary routes of communication from our customers to the Product Management and Engineering teams. A Solutions Engineer is able to really listen to a prospect or customer, understand their requirements, ask the right questions to extract as much information as required and translate all that into a solution with Grafana Labs technology. They are the bridge between the highly technical engineering folks here at Grafana Labs, our customers and our Sales team. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. The Opportunity About our platform Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely. The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, SDLC, security and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads. About the Productivity group We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Productivity group, which owns SDLC tooling, application security and observability, of the resources, systems and workloads used to build and run Grafana Labs products. The group enables product development through the provision of performant and feature-rich SDLC tooling, governing the use and configuration of that tooling.  We are responsible for guiding the product teams in application security good practices, reviewing product changes for security compliance and enabling security functions through self-service automation.  We also own and maintain the internal observability platform, using our own products to give visibility into cloud resource cost, usage and sustainability, and vulnerability management. You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group. We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen. How we work Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on. Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it. What You'll Be Doing Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth. Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity. Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them. Partner with the other Productivity squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours. Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads. Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves. Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response. Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it. We invest heavily in developer productivity. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As an Engineering Manager , you’ll guide GitLab’s dedicated Software Supply Chain Security (SSCS) Add-On engineering team as it develops core capabilities including Dependency Firewall, Build Provenance, Malicious Packages detection, and Artifact Signing . This is a founding management role where you’ll help shape how the team works, partner closely with the Staff Backend Engineer, Product Manager, and SSCS stage management, and turn a defined roadmap into steady, high-quality delivery for enterprise customers with strict security and compliance needs. You’ll focus on developing the team, creating a healthy operating rhythm, and establishing predictable execution for the SSCS SKU. You’ll join a product area where customers in regulated industries are already validating the need, and your work will help GitLab deliver software supply chain security features that customers can rely on. While technical credibility matters, your main focus will be growing a strong backend engineering team, enabling team members in their development, and creating the conditions for long-term delivery and quality. What you’ll do Guide a backend engineering team building the SSCS Add-On across dependency enforcement, build provenance, malicious package detection, and artifact signing. Be responsible for Drive engineering delivery for general availability milestones by aligning sequencing, scope, and dependencies with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. Develop the team by partnering with Talent Acquisition on sourcing, interview design, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions. Run regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that enable growth and clear expectations. Advance engineering quality by monitoring cycle time, defect rates, and test coverage, and by addressing risks early. Coordinate quarterly planning and roadmap tradeoff discussions with SSCS stage leadership and Product. Work with Finance and other partners on headcount pacing and team planning as the Add-On scales. Represent the SSCS Add-On team within stage leadership discussions and help ensure strong communication across functions. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you’ll bring Over 3 years of experience guiding backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments. Ability to hire and grow backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles. Technical credibility to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, CI/CD pipeline security, and signing infrastructure. Experience managing predictable delivery across multi-quarter product roadmaps and managing cross-team dependencies. Comfort working in an asynchronous, documentation-driven organization with clear written communication. Familiarity with supply chain security, artifact management, or compliance-focused product areas, or transferable experience from related domains. Working knowledge of concepts related to frameworks and ecosystems such as SLSA and Sigstore. Ability to build credibility with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders through clear judgment, coaching, and teamwork. About the team The SSCS Add-On team is a product engineering team within GitLab’s Software Supply Chain Security stage. We work on key capabilities in the SSCS Add-On SKU and collaborate closely with product and engineering partners to deliver security features for customers operating in regulated environments. You’ll report to the SSCS Senior Engineering Manager and partner directly with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. As a distributed team working asynchronously across regions, we are focused on strong delivery practices, team health, and scaling the product area with clarity and accountability. For more on how related teams work, see Team Handbook Page . descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Location: Singapore About the Department Cloudforce One is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation. Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers. About INTERDICT I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T. (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions: Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD): Network and application security monitoring for 'Under Attack' mitigation support. PhishGuard: Managed email threat detection and response service. Detection Engineering: ML model development and detection optimization. Together, INTERDICT provides comprehensive 24×7×365 protection across email, application, and network threat surfaces. Role Summary As a Senior Response Engineer within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC), you will serve as a subject-matter expert and technical escalation point for threat mitigation across Cloudflare’s strategic enterprise customer base. In this role, you will lead the response to sophisticated, multi-vector cyberattacks spanning OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7, operating beyond standard playbooks to diagnose anomalies, engineer custom mitigations, and stabilize mission-critical infrastructure under fire. Beyond active incident command, you will act as a force multiplier: architecting customer-specific defense strategies, authoring and refining automated detection logic, mentoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers, and collaborating directly with Cloudflare Product and Engineering teams. We are looking for an experienced, high-ownership technical leader who excels during high-stakes incidents and is passionate about mentoring others while advancing threat mitigation at scale. CMDC operates 24×7×365. This role participates in a regional shift rotation and on-call escalation rota including periodic weekend and public-holiday coverage as part of a follow-the-sun model across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Role Responsibilities Act as the technical lead and incident commander during high-impact, multi-vector security events, designing and deploying bespoke mitigation strategies when standard runbooks do not suffice. Perform deep-dive forensic analysis into complex Layer 3/4 and Layer 7 traffic anomalies, identifying zero-day attack patterns, sophisticated bot networks, and novel evasion techniques. Apply advanced mitigation strategies and filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare’s core security suite, including Magic Transit, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Advanced Rate Limiting. Lead technical communications and incident bridge calls with enterprise C-level executives, principal network engineers, and security teams during critical events, clearly articulating root causes, impact assessments, and remediation paths. Monitor and investigate proactive security alerts across internal telemetry systems to rapidly triage incoming events, assess blast radius, and validate threat severity. Adhere to and champion strict customer SLAs for alert response times, event analysis, and clear executive reporting. Mentor and elevate Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers through structured shadowing, technical post-mortems, and internal training. Partner with internal Engineering and Product teams to translate operational attack trends into prioritized platform enhancements, tool feedback, and automated detection logic. descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About the Role We are hiring Cohere’s first-ever Senior Manager, Talent Development. This role is a blank canvas — there is no established Talent Development function, no inherited catalogue of programs, and no playbook to follow. You will be the first person in this role, with the opportunity to create something from scratch, experiment, and shape how development works across the company. We are growing rapidly, and in 2027 we want to invest seriously in developing our managers, leaders, and people. This role is where that investment will take shape. There is already strong internal demand for this work, and you will own the Talent Development function from strategy and roadmap through to budget, design, and delivery. What You’ll Do Build manager development programs across new managers, experienced managers, and emerging directors. Design, launch, and continuously improve these programs; create engaging cohorts and a community where managers learn from one another. Drive manager effectiveness. Work with HRBPs to identify management challenges and design practical interventions that improve how managers lead, develop, and support their teams. Establish career and competency frameworks across broad role families. Partner with HRBPs and functional leaders to set consistent expectations for growth and progression. Strengthen talent development processes. Build approaches to talent reviews, succession planning, and high-potential development that create meaningful opportunities for employees. Improve onboarding learning experiences. Partner with HR Ops and functional teams to design engaging learning that helps new employees ramp quickly and become effective. Build for scale. Create simple, effective development tools and approaches suited to a fast-growing orginization, including support for integrating new teams as we expand. Own delivery and impact. Manage the roadmap and budget, make pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions, work with external partners, and measure the effectiveness of your initiatives. Establish the function as a valued capability across the company, with the opportunity to build and lead a small team over time. What Success Looks Like Launched foundational development programs for managers and leaders with strong engagement and participation. Established clear career development and competency frameworks across prioritized role families. Created a manager development community that people actively value. Demonstrated measurable improvement in manager effectiveness and development outcomes. Established a scalable Talent Development function with clear priorities, strong HRBP partnerships, and effective use of internal and external resources. Who You Are Proven builder with a track record designing, launching, and delivering manager or leadership development programs with demonstrable impact. 8+ years of experience, including relevant experience in organizational development, career development, competencies, and talent processes. Experience at a fast-growing tech company or scale-up is essential. Practically and commercially minded. You focus on solving real problems rather than introducing unnecessary complexity, and you know when to build, buy, or keep things simple. Exceptional at engagement and facilitation. You can engage demanding or skeptical audiences and create development experiences people genuinely enjoy and value. Strong partner. You build trusted relationships with HRBPs, managers, and leaders, working collaboratively to solve business problems. Able to navigate substantial ambiguity independently. You earn alignment without formal authority and exercise strong judgment on complex decisions. Ambitious to build something lasting. You are excited by the opportunity to establish a capability that scales with the company and grows your impact over time. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds

You will lead through frontline managers and own the technical strategy, coverage model, and customer outcomes across both segments, from discovery and evaluation through production adoption and expansion. Set technical standards for how teams qualify use cases, run evaluations, and guide customers into production across ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API. Set expectations for technical account plans, including milestones for production readiness and adoption. Track technical coverage, technical wins, deployment risks, time to production, adoption, and contribution to revenue growth. These customers are special to us because they aren’t just learning our software; they are learning how to build hiring excellence into the DNA of their growing organizations. Our SMB Customer Success Managers create high-quality onboarding materials, documentation, and e-webinars that enable our customers to get up and running independently. They also jump in to assist via email and customer calls when needed. This is a mid-level role, so we require at least 2 years of experience as a full-time SMB Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or Program Manager. In this role, you’ll take ownership of a book of customers for whom you’d be the main point of contact in our shared inbox and hop on customer calls per our SLAs. You’ll also take ownership of medium and large projects that are core to our team’s operations. Existing projects our team has taken on include: Building an in-app onboarding experience using Amplitude Creation of a live, foundational webinar series + recorded content Building retention best practices into our engagement with customers that extend well beyond just onboarding You should apply if: You have 2+ years of customer-facing experience supporting a complex and rapidly evolving B2B SaaS product (for complexity, think tools like Zapier, HubSpot, and Acuity Scheduling). You enjoy becoming a subject matter and product expert to help deliver excellent experiences when assisting our customers in solving complex challenges. Oftentimes, there will be multiple solutions to any given challenge and you enjoy getting in the weeds with customers to figure out what exactly they need to suggest the best path forward. You’re skilled at defining the scope of problems and creating comprehensive solutions independently and collaboratively. With a complex product comes complex problems - you are excellent at identifying an issue, mapping multiple paths forward, and taking action based on principled thinking. You possess keen attention to detail, ensuring your email and live responses are thorough, clear, and empathetic along the way. Solving the problem is sometimes only half the battle - you are gifted in extracting only the necessary details that our customers or our team members need to solve a problem. You have strong written and verbal communication skills. You effectively communicate with diverse user groups, whether partnering with an experienced TA leader developing the recruiting function at a Series A startup or instructing individuals who are new to recruiting SaaS tools. You are curious—both in addressing customers and creating solutions that improve our workflows. You seek the answers beyond what’s on the surface. Sometimes an answer to a problem may not be obvious at surface level, but you enjoy digging into customer use cases to learn more about their process so you can suggest the best path(s) forward. You should not apply if: You’d prefer to work one-on-one with a small book of customers. The SMB CS Team at Ashby uses a pooled approach (1:many) to allow us to be agile in customer interactions and ensure they have access to the resources they need when they need them. You feel like the customer journey ends once a customer is onboarded. This role may not be right for you if you’re not excited to partner long-term with customers, including ongoing engagement that drives best practices in revenue retention for us and excellent best practices in Ashby for our customers. You don’t enjoy problem-solving. Often, we’re called on to assist customers in solving complex challenges that could have multiple solutions. If you don’t like the idea of problem-solving and troubleshooting what feature works best for companies at varying levels of maturity, then this role may not be right for you. You don’t like projects. A staple of our SMB Customer Success team is that we’ve developed internal processes that allow us to balance our customer interactions with project work that helps drive positive outcomes for our customers and internal teams. You are not keen on speaking up or acting when you see something that could be improved. Our product and internal processes are rapidly changing. This means that we rely heavily on our team members to identify processes/practices that have grown stale and to offer more effective alternatives. About Ashby Customer Success Ashby Customer Success comprises five teams: Product Support SMB Customer Success High Touch Customer Success Recruiting Operations & Professional Services Contracts Management Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us: Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell. As they do that, our GTM teams spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers. We strongly believe small teams with talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than large headcounts. We play a pivotal role in driving success and achieving key milestones by cultivating strong relationships and leveraging our deep understanding of business objectives. With a commitment to excellence and a proactive approach, we are dedicated to empowering our executives and contributing to the overall growth and success of the company. We take pride in creating a work environment that fosters collaboration, open communication, and authenticity, making OpenAI an excellent place to work for highly accomplished professionals. Establish systems to track and log interactions with key external partners, keeping leaders informed and prepared for meetings. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Mexico City, Mexico What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer Manager As a SE Manager for Cloudflare for the LATAM Markets  you will be responsible for managing a cross functional, full sales life cycle and technical activities for Cloudflare customers. The role requires someone with strong leadership, interpersonal, and business acumen to work with Sales to grow our account base. The SE Manager will manage a team of SEs that are geographically distributed within the US and Mexico, covering all of the countries that make up LATAM for Cloudflare.  The SE team partners with the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Public Sector LATAM Sales teams that are also geographically distributed in the US and Mexico, as well as Customer Success and is responsible for providing the value of Cloudflare products to customers and prospects Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, experience and goals Our Solutions Engineers come from a wide range of backgrounds: financial consulting, engineering, software development, product management, customer support & project delivery. We're serious about building a diverse team. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology. Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and people, and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms, and you like coaching and teaching. You are naturally curious, and an avid builder who is not afraid to get your hands dirty. On the Solutions Engineering team, you will find a collaborative environment where everyone brings different strengths and jumps in to help each other and you will be an integral part of driving that culture. Requirements 5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems or another related field or its equivalent. 3+ years of experience with internet technologies / protocols and / or cloud technologies Minimum 1 year of team lead/team management experience Experience managing opportunity sales cycles and identifying technical proof activities  Demonstrated operations and organization skills implementation and driving best practices with cross functional organizations. Strong organizational and analytical skills. Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven track record of successfully building collaboration around important initiatives. Successful track record of working and influencing matrixed organizations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively present technical and business related subjects to all audiences. Demonstrated problem solving skills, drive for results, interpersonal savvy, and customer focus. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI's Legal team works on the legal questions that arise from developing and deploying advanced AI. Our Security and Public Sector Legal team helps protect OpenAI's people, technology, and services and supports their safe and responsible use. We partner closely with technical and operational teams to provide clear advice, navigate sensitive matters, and build practical safeguards. About the Role We are seeking an Associate General Counsel to advise across national security, cybersecurity, and platform abuse investigations and help build the programs and processes that support our work as OpenAI continues to scale. You will combine exceptional legal judgment with substantial in-house experience, turning complex requirements into effective day-to-day operations. You will own a varied portfolio, lead sensitive matters, and help teams move from individual solutions to consistent, well-run programs. We are looking for someone who enjoys both counseling on difficult questions and doing the detailed work of implementation: defining responsibilities, securing alignment, developing useful processes, and making sure they work in practice. You will report to the Deputy General Counsel leading Security and Public Sector Legal and work closely with Security, Product Policy, Global Affairs, and colleagues across Legal. This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Washington, DC. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. You’ll be responsible for: Advising on national security and security issues affecting AI development and deployment, including protecting sensitive technology, responding to incidents, and working with government and industry partners. Leading or supporting sensitive security and internal investigations, advising on scope, evidence, investigative methods, and practical remediation in partnership with the other legal and operational leads. Providing day-to-day counseling on cybersecurity, physical security, insider risk, threat intelligence, and information sharing. Building and scaling legal programs, including intake and triage, repeatable business guidance, playbooks, and measures of effectiveness. Counseling senior leaders through ambiguous decisions, preparing concise recommendations and executive updates, and managing outside counsel and other resources effectively. Partnering with specialists in privacy, product, employment, investigations, law enforcement response, trade compliance, and public-sector matters, and taking on emerging issues across the team's portfolio. We’re looking for someone with: 15+ years of relevant legal experience, including substantial in-house experience at a technology company and responsibility for building or scaling legal, security, investigations, or compliance programs. Strong expertise in national security, cybersecurity, or investigations and a demonstrated ability to advise effectively across adjacent areas. A record of personally implementing programs, securing adoption, and improving decisions, execution, or risk management as an organization grew. Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to give clear, practical advice when the facts or legal framework are incomplete. The ability to build trust across functions, resolve differences constructively, and combine independent judgment with shared priorities and reliable execution. Clear, concise writing, the ability to learn unfamiliar technical subjects quickly, and comfort moving between strategic counseling and detailed operational work. A JD and an active license or qualification to practice law in your jurisdiction. descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About the role: Cohere is at the forefront of AI innovation, building cutting-edge language models and AI systems. Our Finance team plays a critical role in supporting our rapid growth and ensuring operational excellence. We value technical expertise, collaborative problem-solving, and a commitment to accuracy and compliance. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our financial infrastructure while working at the intersection of finance and transformative technology. As we scale globally, you will play a pivotal role in transforming our Procure-to-Pay (P2P) engine, safeguarding company assets, and partnering cross-functionally with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Department Leads to drive spend visibility and operational rigor. In this role, you will: Own End-to-End Global AP: Direct daily multi-entity, multi-currency accounts payable operations globally, ensuring invoices are accurately coded, approved, and paid on schedule. Build SOX-Ready Infrastructure: Overhaul AP workflows to meet public-company standards, designing and maintaining documented, testable internal controls (including segregation of duties, vendor master file governance, and payment release controls). Drive Automation & AI Adoption: Lead the implementation and optimization of modern P2P/AP automation platforms, corporate card programs, and AI-assisted invoice processing to maximize touchless rates and eliminate manual reconciliations. Manage Month-End Close & Tax Compliance: Own the AP close calendar, partnering with GL accounting on accrued liabilities, prepaid amortization schedules, and reconciliations, while ensuring full compliance with 1099s, W-8/W-9s, and Canadian GST/HST/VAT requirements. Partner Cross-Functionally: Design scalable approval hierarchies and exception workflows for urgent payments, acting as the primary point of escalation for internal stakeholders and strategic vendors. Lead & Develop the Team: Supervise, coach, and scale a high-performing AP team, establishing clear SLAs and tracking KPIs You may be a good fit if you: Have 7+ years of progressive Accounts Payable experience, including 3+ years managing and coaching a team in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. Possess hands-on experience building or operating SOX-compliant AP controls and supporting external financial statement audits (PCAOB experience is a strong plus). Have deep proficiency with NetSuite and have led implementations or integrations of modern P2P/corporate card platforms (e.g., Ramp, Zip, Brex, or similar). Bring solid working knowledge of multi-currency transactions and North American tax/regulatory requirements (US 1099s, W-8/W-9, Canadian GST/HST). Are an automation-first builder who thrives in ambiguity, spots process bottlenecks early, and leverages modern tools (including AI) to scale operations without linearly scaling headcount. Communicate clearly and empathetically with non-finance stakeholders, enforcing policy guardrails while keeping the business moving. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. The Opportunity  Grafana Labs is looking for an Analyst Relations (AR) Manager to own our relationships with the industry analyst community, including Gartner, Forrester, IDC, GigaOm, and others, and to run the programs that turn those relationships into visibility, credibility, and pipeline influence. You'll manage the full analyst lifecycle: building and nurturing analyst relationships, running Analyst Days, driving our participation in Magic Quadrants and other evaluations, managing commissioned research, and partnering with analyst firms on joint surveys and reports. This role sits at the intersection of product marketing, communications, and competitive intelligence, and reports to the Director of AR and PR. Maintain a regular cadence of proactive briefings, inquiry calls, and informal check-ins to keep analysts current on Grafana Labs' roadmap, customer momentum, and market position. Plan and run Analyst Day(s), including agenda design, executive and SME participation, content development, and post-event follow-up. Design and field surveys and joint research initiatives in partnership with analyst firms, from questionnaire design through report publication and internal/external distribution. Maintain a shared calendar of all evaluation cycles, submission windows, and research deliverables across the AR program. Content, Enablement & Cross-Functional Coordination Prepare executives and subject-matter experts for analyst briefings and inquiries, including briefing decks, talking points, and Q&A prep. Build and maintain the AR content library: positioning documents, fact sheets, RFI/questionnaire responses, and reusable proof points. Partner with product marketing, competitive intelligence, PR/comms, and the executive team to align analyst messaging with the broader company narrative and launch timing. Program Measurement & Operations Define and report on AR program KPIs, including evaluation positioning trends, share of voice, analyst-influenced pipeline, and stakeholder satisfaction. Own the AR budget, including analyst firm subscriptions/contracts and commissioned research spend; manage vendor relationships and renewals. Monitor for and coordinate rapid response to analyst commentary that could affect brand or competitive positioning. Synthesize and distribute analyst research and competitive insight internally (e.g., briefing summaries, an internal analyst newsletter) to keep sales, product, and leadership informed. What Makes You a Great Fit 6+ years of experience in analyst relations, communications, product marketing, or competitive intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or infrastructure/observability/monitoring software. Direct experience managing Magic Quadrant, Wave, or similar analyst evaluation submissions. Proven experience using AI to support workflows and build automations/applications. Established familiarity with major analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, IDC, GigaOm) and their methodologies. Experience commissioning or managing third-party research (e.g., TEI studies, custom surveys). Strong project management skills; comfortable owning multiple concurrent deadlines across teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the polish to prep and coach executives. Data-literate: comfortable scoping surveys, interpreting research results, and translating findings into narrative. Collaborative, cross-functional operator who can influence without direct authority. Willingness to travel for analyst events and briefings (~15–20%). descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations:  Austin, TX San Francisco, CA New York, NY Remote, US About the Department Cloudflare helps build a better Internet and the Emerging Technology and Incubation (ETI) team invents, launches, and brings to market new technologies built on Cloudflare's network. ETI makes dozens of bets on the future of the Internet and takes the ones that work to market. ETI started in 2016 and incubated several of Cloudflare's major product lines, including Zero Trust and the Developer Platform. Today ETI is focused on the agentic Internet: how AI agents find, read, and pay for content and services, and how creators and companies get paid as agents become a larger share of Internet traffic. Every bet in ETI follows the same loop: test an idea, build the smallest version that tells us something, get real feedback, iterate, and ship. The team moves quickly and works closely with teams across Cloudflare. About the Role You will be Chief of Staff to the head of ETI, working alongside the product managers and engineering leaders on each bet. You will help the head of ETI stay high level while you handle much of the execution. You will be read in on almost everything in the portfolio, so discretion matters. Over time, you will represent them in meetings. Operations and Strategic Initiatives: Lead the strategic initiatives that start in ETI or rely on the ETI team. These can include acquisition due diligence and integration, partnerships that extend Cloudflare's technology to new customers, and anything else the portfolio needs. Build the tooling and workflows ETI is missing, thinking through the dependencies. Team and Project Management: Run the operating rhythm with the teams. Drive decisions and plans to closure, follow through on what is owed, and prep and close out the big moments such as planning cycles, onsites, and key forums. The teams will trust you to help set priorities across the group and to own new projects or dependencies. You will partner with the executive assistant, who handles booking, expenses, and logistics, while you help prioritize the calendar. Research and Analysis: Get into the details with the teams: research and analysis, solving problems, and producing the docs and materials the head of ETI needs while keeping them human. You will be a real sounding board, with useful commentary and feedback. Communications: Help ETI tell its story, internally and, with the Communications team, externally. Own the presentations and materials ETI shares, including retrospectives and celebrations, and help the product, engineering, and marketing teams get the inputs they need to tell specific stories. Who you are A suitable candidate gets into the details and understands them while keeping the high-level view, figures out ways to make things work, and communicates with grace and empathy inside and outside of Cloudflare. You work independently and ask for help when you need it. You solve thorny problems by getting to first principles and then aligning the team on the goal; executing, learning, and adapting. Gets into the weeds and really understands the details, while keeping the high-level perspective Systems minded: thinks through dependencies and how the pieces fit together High agency: figures out ways to make things work Deeply curious: wants to know how and why the world works and is always learning Learns enough about how the Internet, crypto, and business work to give useful insight and make decisions on their own Builds well with LLMs, even if not a developer, shown by clear communication, structured thinking, and ownership of tasks Works comfortably with senior leaders and handles confidential information with discretion Excellent written and verbal communication skills A high degree of attention to detail The ability to work in a fast-moving and ever-changing environment A desire to receive feedback and grow   Compensation Application Deadline: February 21, 2027 Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: London, the UK About the role The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA, specifically UKI. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation.
