descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, TX About The Department Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployed across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet. About The Role We need to make thoughtful infrastructure choices affecting a significant portion of the Internet. Hardware we work with includes servers and components, as well as PDUs and network hardware. Collaborate with the Site Reliability Engineering team to onboard and integrate the next generation of servers into provisioning tools and fleet management tools. Collaborate with performance team and software teams to optimize software performance on the hardware Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deploy firmware updates, triage hardware problem reports, resolve hardware issues, maintain automation tools.  Communicate your results and updates through blog posts and internal talks Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science Extensive experience with compute design engineering, validation, performance benchmarking, debugging, and deployment used in the data center Knowledge of CPU architectures, preferably both x86 and ARM Knowledge and experience with server hardware including motherboard designs, CPU architecture, memory & storage technology Knowledge of performance benchmarking ; Previous experience in testing, measuring, and/or simulating hardware performance and an understanding of no-stone-left-unturned experimentation Knowledge of bash, python and basic Linux task automation Knowledge of Redfish, IPMI and server remote management protocols, and experience with firmware updates Curiosity and desire to learn about the Cloudflare hardware and products used by 20% of all web sites Desire to learn how a diverse server fleet is managed at scale with tools such as traffic management, capacity planning and failover mechanisms Desire to learn the tools Cloudflare uses to maintain and monitor our hardware Bonus Points Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Compute Science Experience of performance optimization based on hardware / software codesign Experience of kernel development, compiler optimization, or driver development. Experience of working with external vendors on server hardware qualification. Experience of observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, as well as the ability to observe trends over time Experience with software development tools and processes such as Git, TeamCity and Jira Experience in a hyperscale cloud infrastructure role also valuable Knowledge of debugging server hardware faults and the ability to engage with our sourcing team and vendors to improve quality Knowledge of XPU/accelerator architectures is a plus Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a hands-on Launch Producer to build and run a repeatable, scalable creative production engine for Business Marketing launches, spanning new models, products, and capabilities, as well as solutions and use cases. You’ll help shape the right creative and video approach for each launch, then lead production from brief through delivery. Most launches center on owned and social channels, and leverage video as a primary medium to explain new products and capabilities. Our largest launches also shape broader brand marketing, requiring coordination with Integrated Marketing and Media. This role combines building the system with running the work. You should be equally comfortable improving a workflow, leading a shoot, and partnering with a motion designer. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL Lead launch intake and planning, aligning creative scope, resources, and timelines with launch priorities. Partner with Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, creative leads, and subject-matter experts to translate launch goals, audiences, messaging, and technical capabilities into compelling briefs, scripts, demos, and customer stories. Produce videos at varying levels of fidelity, including demos, motion graphics, sizzle videos, explainers, and talking-head or testimonial videos featuring OpenAI talent and customers. Lead production end to end: budgets, schedules, resourcing, shoots, post-production, and delivery. Consolidate feedback and approvals, manage dependencies, and surface risks and decisions early so assets are ready to ship. Partner with Creative Operations to assemble and manage the right production team for each launch, drawing on your trusted bench of freelancers, agencies, and production partners alongside internal talent. Set clear scopes, expectations, and quality standards. Plan assets for owned and social distribution, including formats, cutdowns, and channel-specific adaptations. Coordinate usage rights, accessibility, quality control, and final delivery requirements with the relevant partners. Partner with Demand teams to translate launch strategy into demand-generation creative, informing briefs, asset needs, and cutdowns while those teams own demand execution. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing and Media on major launches with broader brand and paid-media implications. Build reusable workflows, templates, and production approaches. Use AI-enabled tools, post-launch learnings, and asset performance to improve speed, quality, and effectiveness without adding unnecessary process. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE Experience: 12+ years in integrated creative production, digital production, program management, or a related field, with a proven track record of managing complex creative initiatives. A true operator’s mindset: you can build a reliable production system and keep multiple launches moving through it. Strong storytelling and creative judgment, with hands-on experience leading video shoots and working with motion designers, editors, and other production specialists. An established network of creative and production talent, and sound judgment about the right team, scope, and approach for each brief, budget, and timeline. Fluency in post-production and delivering assets across social, owned, and demand channels. Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative working style. You build trust across disciplines, make tradeoffs visible, and keep teams aligned through shifting priorities. A scrappy, resourceful approach and comfort with ambiguity and tight timelines. You know when a simple demo is enough and when a launch needs a more ambitious treatment. A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end production leadership across fast-turn and larger-scale work, with your specific contribution and outcomes clearly identified. You'll develop renewal strategies, forecast outcomes, and coordinate with Sales and Customer Success to address risks and support long-term customer relationships. You'll also improve renewal workflows so customers experience seamless continuity with GitLab's platform. Some examples of our projects: Implementing automated outreach sequences to engage customers throughout their renewal lifecycle Enhancing customer experience by integrating adoption data and personalized communications into renewal processes What you’ll do Own the renewal process for a portfolio of public sector customers, developing account-level strategies and coordinating renewal activities from planning through completion. Strong communication skills with confidence to engage in business conversations and deliver excellent customer experiences. Customer-centric approach with high empathy, focused on building long-term relationships and driving customer satisfaction. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who can demonstrate the experience and transferable skills needed to own renewal outcomes. About the role As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer, you will take backend features and improvements from clarifying the problem through shipping them and following up in production. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow. Why you’ll love this role Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users. Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment. Innovative Culture: You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to. Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success. User-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what. What you’ll do Own and Ship Features: Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages. Build for Production: Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior. Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk. Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. Leverage AI: Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter. On Call Support: Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you’ll bring Backend Fundamentals: Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals. Adaptability: Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language. Feature Ownership: The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time. Practical Judgment: Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling. Clear Communication: Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment. AI Fluency: Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate. Helpful experience Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC. Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment. Lead senior advertiser and agency relationships. Work with marketing, analytics, and business leaders to define what success looks like, resolve complex measurement questions, and translate evidence into investment and optimization decisions. Build first- and third-party measurement capabilities. Partner with global teams and regional providers across verification, attribution, incrementality, brand lift, sales lift, visitation, and marketing mix modeling (MMM), adapting approaches to local data availability and market needs. Set the standard for measurement quality. Guide study design, power analysis, diagnostics, and interpretation. This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning opportunity assessment, partnership design, commercial negotiation, and execution. You will own the partner work behind product initiatives, from defining partner needs through launch and sustained adoption at scale. These may include enterprise platform capabilities and industry-specific offerings. You bring a generalist’s ability to connect product priorities with partner capabilities, build a business case, and align teams around a practical path forward. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: The Field Engineering team works closely with our Presales Solution Engineering team, as well as Product and Marketing, to ensure the SE's have the tools, collateral, enablement and experts they need to close business. If you've ever served in a Technical Presales role for a software company, you know just how much knowledge you are expected to have, demos you need to show, workshops you need to execute on, etc. The Field Engineering team maintains the backend systems, content creation and deep subject matter expertise that enables the Solution Engineering team to scale and focus on direct customer selling, community building, learning, and other adoption and revenue-focused activities. As a Staff Field Engineer, you are viewed by Sales and FE leadership as being in the top 20% of the field team, operating with little to no supervision on the company's most strategic engagements and serving as a mentor to Senior Field Engineers and Solution Engineers. What You'll Be Doing: Advise on and support some of Grafana's most strategic deals and customer engagements, collaborating with Solution Engineers and Observability Architects on the company's most complex technical challenges with no supervision.  Serve as a company-recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) in one area of the Grafana Platform, and deep knowledge across multiple Grafana technologies, building new reference architectures from scratch and overcoming competitive objections in the field Proven ability to craft and deliver compelling value based stories to help the sales team technically close deals. Own end-to-end creation and curation of technical training content (workshops, how-to guides, demo scripts) for one or more product areas, and establish a repeatable content review cadence in partnership with Enablement and Product Management to keep materials aligned with the product roadmap Architect, engineer, and maintain a live production environment that supports demo, workshop, and POV infrastructure at scale, ensuring reliability, security, and uptime. Act as a key influencer in product direction, helping key customers adopt newer technologies, and represent Field Engineering in Product planning cycles to surface enablement gaps and shape investment priorities Serve as a presenter for Strategic Marketing events (presentations, panels, webinars, conferences, blogs) as an ambassador for Grafana Provide technical guidance for a specific product area to Solution Engineers, Observability Architects and customers, and present best practices to customers Help update and improve product documentation, and contribute back to the organization through white papers, blogs, and product direction input Mentor Senior and Staff Solution Engineers and Field Engineers What Makes You a Great Fit: Minimum of 8+ years of related technical experience, including 2+ years in a Senior Field Engineer role (or equivalent), serving as a SRE, Developer, Architect and/or successful presales Solution Architect. OSS development experience is a plus. Excellent understanding of Grafana and associated technologies, with recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) depth in at least one area of the Grafana Platform; deep working knowledge across multiple technologies in the Observability space (e.g. Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, Tempo, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, etc.) Expert-level knowledge in at least one adjacent domain (e.g. IoT, AI/ML) beyond the core observability stack, and demonstrated domain knowledge across the broader Grafana Ecosystem Has created and maintained at least one product training asset (workshop, guide, or structured content) that has been adopted by the broader technical field organization Demonstrated experience partnering cross-functionally with Product Management and Engineering to produce and maintain field-facing enablement content and influence roadmap priorities Comfortable with at least one modern programming language, and a strong understanding of the modern software development lifecycle, including debugging and investigation Working familiarity with Linux, including common tools Practical experience using AI tools to generate and review code and to accelerate day-to-day tasks, while retaining full ownership of final decisions and quality criteria for the resulting work Able to architect a modern application on one of the primary cloud providers (AWS, Azure or GCP), including IaC tools such as Terraform, understanding the tradeoffs between build vs. buy, and the technologies that make up that architecture such as Kubernetes, Docker, Serverless, Microservices and more Proven track recor

descriptionAr: Why Design at Langfuse Your work will shape how engineers build with AI. Langfuse is the primary interface engineers use to debug, evaluate, and improve their LLM applications. The experience you ship will be used for hours each day by thousands of developers and non-developers. They'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community Slack channels. Everything we build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. The design challenges here are genuinely hard. You're designing for technical users and business users alike who care about information density, speed, and precision. For example, traces contain dozens of nested LLM calls with megabyte long prompts and completions. Users need to set up evaluators, manage skill versions, configure our AI gateway or integrations, and build monitoring dashboards before they even start analyzing results. You need to make both the setup and the daily use feel intuitive and easy. You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. Deeply understanding the problems our users solve will make you a better designer and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. For the past few years, we focused mainly on building LLM infrastructure that scales to massive volumes and stays cheap to run. Over the last year, we made design a cornerstone of our product team, because we learned that great infrastructure only pays off when the product feels seamless to use. You will grow at Langfuse by Owning our product design end-to-end. You will be assigned to the most challenging and business critical product launches we work on at Langfuse. To understand how to make the feature great, you will talk to users, our marketing team, and our engineers to understand what needs to be solved. You are then responsible for making the experience for our users as seamless as possible. Making data-dense interfaces intuitive. Langfuse surfaces traces, scores, costs, latencies, token counts, prompt versions, and evaluation results. You'll figure out how to present complex, nested data in ways that help engineers find what they need fast. Simplifying complex workflows. Evals, experiments, prompt and skill versions, and monitoring involve a lot of steps today. We're making Halo, our in-app agent, the place where they come together, with AI-generated UI and workflows built into many parts of Langfuse. You'll design these new ways of working so they feel obvious in hindsight. Collaborating directly with product engineers. You'll pair with engineers, whiteboard solutions together, and ship designs that work with our design system. You'll create reusable, consistent UI patterns that the whole team can build with. Shipping design straight to code. You'll use AI coding tools to implement smaller design fixes, build components for the design system, and polish UI details yourself. We are not looking for a perfect engineer here but for someone who can help themselves. What we're looking for 7+ years of experience in designing complex web applications, incl. a portfolio showcasing product work that users loved Experience taking products from features from zero to one in a fast-paced environment Strong product mindset, with a focus on UX and clear understanding of tradeoffs The ability to think in systems. Your patterns and components hold up across the whole product and stay consistent as it grows Excited about open source software and dev tools We are launching new features on a daily basis. While you focus on your primary project, engineers will ask for help on smaller topics continuously. You need to be able to prioritize yourself and understand where to go deep and where to go with an 80:20 approach. Bonus points: Leverage AI in your workflows to design, build, test, and ship to production ML/AI experience or familiarity with the LLM tooling ecosystem Former founder or early startup experience Contributions to open source projects or design systems Side projects that show curiosity Stellar visual craft No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply. More about working at Langfuse How we work Blog post on Design at Langfuse Our roadmap Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s Integrity team protects people and businesses using ChatGPT, Codex, and the API from fraud, abuse, and harmful misuse. Our work spans payment and promotional abuse, compromised accounts and API credentials, business and advertiser integrity, and emerging misuse of frontier AI capabilities. We also help product teams measure authentic usage so that abuse doesn’t distort decisions about how our products are growing. Integrity Data Science helps teams decide where to intervene and whether those interventions work. A payment control can prevent fraud while blocking legitimate purchases. A product launch can make it easier for customers to get started while creating new opportunities for abuse. We measure both sides of those decisions. About the Role As a Data Scientist on Integrity, you’ll find emerging abuse patterns, size their impact, and lead the analytical work behind decisions about detection, enforcement, and product launches. You’ll work with Product, Engineering, Research, Policy, and Operations to turn findings into improvements and measure what happens after they ship. Investigate anomalous activity across products. Estimate how common a problem is, who is affected, and what it costs users or the business. Use that evidence to recommend where to focus. Define outcome metrics and guardrails, establish baselines, and build monitoring that surfaces changes in abuse, customer friction, and operational performance. Help build and evaluate detection rules, classifiers, and human review workflows. Use labeled samples and review outcomes to understand what the systems miss, where they flag legitimate activity, and how those errors vary across users and products. Design randomized holdouts and use quasi-experimental or observational methods when randomization is impractical. Estimate harm or fraud losses prevented alongside effects on legitimate users, revenue, compute costs, and review workload. Recommend whether to launch, expand, adjust, or retire a control. Trace where signals, review decisions, or enforcement actions break down. Work with partners to close gaps and build reusable datasets, analyses, and investigation tools. Ideal Candidate You use AI tools to investigate large, messy datasets, test hypotheses quickly, and automate recurring analyses. You’re fluent in SQL and Python and can verify AI-generated queries, code, and conclusions against the underlying data. You have strong statistical judgment and experience with experimentation, causal inference, or observational analysis. You can reason from incomplete or biased labels and explain how uncertainty affects a decision. You take ownership of open-ended problems, from deciding what to measure through recommending an action and checking whether it worked. You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners and can explain the tradeoffs behind a recommendation. Experience in integrity, trust and safety, fraud or risk analytics, security analytics, or applied ML evaluation is helpful. Experience evaluating detection systems, human review, or LLM-based classifiers is a plus. descriptionAr: About the Team The Integrity team is responsible for the scaled systems that help identify and respond to bad actors and harm on OpenAI’s platforms. We protect users and the wider world by developing responses to complex harms and building the harm protections needed for new product and model launches. Integrity’s work spans not only across frontier harms like biological weapons and cybersecurity, but also high severity abuses such as child safety, nation-state misuse, and violence. About the Role Protection Scientists within Integrity design, orchestrate, and mature systems of defence against usage harms enabled by OpenAI's products. We are systems thinkers that combine deep harm domain expertise with breadth across investigation, data science, machine learning, policy and operations. Our distinctive strength is understanding how these disciplines fit together and translating between them to design and build effective systems of defence. In San Francisco, we are hiring for protection work focused on sextortion, trafficking, national security (including nation-state misuse), and jailbreaks. Depending on your domain expertise, your work could include identifying AI-enabled coercion and exploitation, detecting misuse that supports trafficking, uncovering coordinated activity by state-linked actors, or investigating attempts to circumvent model safeguards. You will translate these evolving threats into detection systems and interventions that reduce harm. Your core hands-on technical responsibility is harm detection. You will design, build, evaluate and maintain production detection systems, drawing on investigative expertise, data and shared engineering platforms. You will develop signals and classifiers that identify abusive behaviour and patterns across accounts and activity, and adapt them as adversaries change tactics. You will also own the strategy and cross-functional delivery of protection work for a harm area or product launch. Working closely with investigators and other domain experts, you will ground the design in a deep understanding of how the harm occurs and translate that understanding into a system of defence. You will connect detection with policy, review, interventions, enforcement and measurement, continually calibrating the system against real cases and expert judgement as it scales. You will identify what needs to be built or changed and make it happen. Success requires setting clear priorities, aligning partners, resolving dependencies and communicating evidence, decisions and trade-offs crisply. It also requires a willingness to jump in and work directly on whatever is blocking system effectiveness, using your breadth of skills. This role is based in our San Francisco office and includes participation in an on-call rotation that may involve resolving urgent escalations outside normal working hours. Some investigations may involve sensitive content, including sexual, violent or otherwise disturbing material. In this role, you will: Define and drive protection strategy for a harm area or launch. Translate ambiguous risks into goals, priorities and roadmaps, and make trade-offs based on evidence, risk and available capacity. Directly build and maintain harm detection. Develop production signals, classifiers and pipelines using SQL, Python, machine learning and language models, integrating with shared engineering platforms. Lead cross-functional execution. Translate between specialist roles, establish shared understanding and ownership, resolve technical and organisational dependencies, and communicate recommendations and specific asks clearly. Investigate exploitation and national security threats within your area of focus. descriptionAr: Location and travel You can be based in Europe; across several countries that we hire in. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job. Why this role? Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications. However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks. We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum. The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable. What you'll do Represent Langfuse at conferences, meetups, workshops, customer events, partner events, and community gatherings across Europe Run live demos and technical sessions on tracing, evals, prompt management, datasets, metrics, and related LLM engineering workflows. Build and maintain field-ready material: demo flows, workshop runbooks, talk abstracts, event landing pages, follow-up emails, signup flows, and conference-in-a-box assets. Organize Langfuse-hosted meetups, workshops, dinners, and smaller technical gatherings around the highest-quality audiences. Partner with ClickHouse field marketing, sales, solutions, product marketing, and engineering teams where it helps Langfuse show up well. Turn event learnings into useful artifacts: better messaging, better demos, better docs, better talks, better customer stories, and sharper product feedback. What we're looking for You have worked in DevRel, product marketing engineering, solutions engineering, field engineering, developer advocacy, or technical community roles. You have spoken at developer conferences, meetups, workshops, webinars, or technical customer events. You already create technical content, demos, videos, talks, open source projects, or educational material. You should be excited to travel, give talks, run demos, host events, talk to developers and technical leaders, and bring what you learn back into the company. You care about developer experience, open source, AI engineering, and the quality of the rooms you spend time in. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can independently decide what to do before there is a mature playbook. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely. A strong plus: You are a former engineer, or deeply technical operator who can credibly explain software to experienced developers. descriptionAr: The Role Our commercial segment — companies with up to 500 employees — is predominantly developer- and engineer-led. These buyers don't respond to decks and discovery scripts. They respond to someone who speaks their language, understands their architecture, and can help them think through a real problem. That's who we're hiring. As a Commercial Account Executive at ClickHouse, you'll own the full sales cycle for inbound, product-led, and self-serve accounts in this segment. You'll engage with data engineers, platform teams, and technical founders at the moment they're evaluating ClickHouse for a real use case — and your job is to help them succeed, faster. The best deals in this segment don't feel like sales. They feel like an engineering consultation that ends in a contract. Our commercial customers include companies like Applied Compute , Instinct , WorkOS , Prime Intellect , Browserbase , Temporal , TypeSafe AI , and Blacksmith — developer-first products that chose ClickHouse because they needed something that could handle billions of events without slowing down their users. The best deals in this segment don't feel like sales. They feel like an engineering consultation that ends in a contract. This is a role for technically strong people who are ready to own a number. You'll need at least 1-2 years of closing experience, and technical credibility is non-negotiable. What You Will Be Doing Own the full sales cycle from inbound lead to close for accounts in the sub-250 employee segment, with a focus on speed, technical depth, and conversion quality. Engage directly with data engineers, platform architects, and technical founders to understand their use cases, data volumes, query patterns, and infrastructure requirements — and map those to ClickHouse capabilities. Troubleshoot schema design questions, ingestion patterns, and integration challenges during the evaluation process; serve as a trusted technical advisor rather than a traditional sales rep. Identify expansion opportunities within the existing self-serve and product-led customer base; convert usage signals into meaningful commercial relationships. Partner with Solutions Engineers on more complex evaluations, and advocate for customer needs internally with Product and Engineering. Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene — documenting technical context, decision criteria, stakeholders, and next steps in Salesforce so nothing falls through the cracks. Contribute to playbooks, technical objection handling guides, and onboarding materials that help the team scale what's working. Participate in developer community events, technical meetups, and online forums where our users naturally gather. What You Bring At least 1-2 years of closing experience carrying a quota, ideally selling technical or data infrastructure products to engineering buyers. A technical foundation that earns respect in engineering conversations — built through experience as a data engineer, solutions engineer/architect, software engineer, or similar role. Comfort with the modern data stack: columnar databases, streaming ingestion (Kafka, Kinesis), cloud infrastructure, and SQL-heavy analytics workflows. Hands-on experience with ClickHouse, DuckDB, Druid, Pinot, BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar is a strong plus. Some customer-facing experience — whether in pre-sales, technical account management, solutions engineering, or a customer-success capacity. You've navigated technical conversations with real stakes before. An instinct for moving quickly. This segment runs on short cycles. You know how to drive urgency without being pushy, and how to remove technical blockers that stall deals. Strong written and verbal communication. You can simplify complex concepts without dumbing them down, and you write clearly enough that your emails actually get responses from engineers. Curiosity about the business side of technology. You're interested in understanding why companies buy, not just what they're building. Ownership mentality. You're comfortable operating with autonomy, making judgment calls without a playbook, and learning from what doesn't work. Why This Role Is Different Most AE roles are execution roles. This one is a craft role. You'll build deep product knowledge, learn how high-growth companies architect for scale, and develop commercial skills in an environment where your technical instincts are your biggest competitive advantage. For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to bridge two worlds — and get paid competitively to do it. If you've been an early leader in a region before and want to do it again with a technically differentiated product, this role is for you. What You'll Do Build the region from the ground up. Own the Southeast territory plan, including which accounts, verticals, and metros to prioritize first, and where to place each new rep. Recruit and close top-tier AEs. Use your regional network to hire a team of Enterprise AEs and keep growing it. Hire for technical curiosity, a proven record against a number, and high integrity. Own the number. Carry the regional quota and forecast it accurately every week, month, and quarter. Run rigorous pipeline and deal reviews using a MEDDPICC-style qualification standard. Land and expand enterprise accounts. Convert existing ClickHouse Cloud and open-source usage into committed enterprise agreements, then grow them as new use cases emerge. The Southeast's enterprise base spans financial services, payments, healthcare, logistics, retail, and media. Get into deals. Join executive meetings, pressure-test deal strategy, and help reps through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving technical buyers, procurement, and security review. Run a tight team with Solutions Architects. Work hand in hand with SAs and SEs so every opportunity is technically sound and every customer is set up to grow. Work the full GTM machine. Partner with Marketing, Partners/Alliances (including cloud marketplaces), and our product-led growth motion to build pipeline and pick up self-serve accounts ready for a sales-assisted conversation. Be ClickHouse's face in the Southeast. Build our presence with customers, partners, and the local data and developer community through executive events, meetups, and field programs. What You Bring 10+ years of enterprise software sales in data infrastructure, databases, analytics, observability, or cloud, including a strong record as a quota-carrying seller. 5+ years leading enterprise sales teams as a first- or second-line leader, with consistent attainment you can walk us through number by number. A record of building a region or team from an early stage: hiring the first reps, defining territories, and growing a new geography into a predictable business. A deep Southeast network of enterprise AEs, customers, and partners, and a reputation that makes strong sellers want to work for you. Forecasting and qualification discipline (MEDDPICC or similar). descriptionAr: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About the Role: Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As an SC for the Enterprise market for France, you’ll own the full customer journey: from prospecting, first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. About Notion in France While our local team is still growing, France is already Notion’s largest market in EMEA by number of users. Teams at more than 80% of CAC 40 companies use Notion, and we’re proud to support French organisations including Qonto, Pennylane, Alan and AXA Climate. As we grow our presence in France, you’ll have the opportunity to build on that momentum and help shape what comes next. ⁠⁠ ⁠⁠ ⁠⁠ ⁠⁠ What You'll Achieve: Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed Build and own a strong pipeline of self-sourced opportunities across your target accounts through proactive outbound prospecting. Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption Skills You'll Need to Bring: Experience selling technical products to technical buyers in the enterprise segment (3000+ employees) Be a self-starter who owns your pipeline —proactively generating opportunities through prospecting and outbound outreach, and driving them from first contact through to conversion. Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room Strong prospecting, discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles Strong You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems A self-starter who owns your pipeline—proactively generating opportunities through prospecting and outbound outreach, and driving them from first contact through to conversion You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working Native or bilingual level fluency French business-level English proficiency. Nice to Haves: Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity  Grafana Labs is looking for a  Major Account Executive based in The Netherlands who will be responsible for managing some of our largest enterprise accounts in the Benelux region . You will identify, nurture and close opportunities within your assigned install base, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before. What You’ll Be Doing Identify new opportunities to expand Grafana usage within a set of current customers Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, negotiations and account management) Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests What Makes You a Great Fit: 6+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer) Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually Fluent in English & Dutch.   Bonus Points For:   Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage Experience using Salesforce Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal Compensation & Reward  In the Netherlands, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 280,000 - EUR 293,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture -  As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.  Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. descriptionAr: About this Team At OpenAI, we’re here to do something extraordinary: build safe AGI that benefits everyone. That mission demands people who are not just brilliant but also deeply aligned with our values. Our Recruiting team is the gateway connecting exceptional humans to meaningful, high-impact work. We’re a close-knit, mission-driven crew that takes pride in thoughtful, relationship-first hiring. We partner deeply with teams across OpenAI to find, engage, and support the people who will shape the future of AI. About this Role We’re looking for an experienced Business Recruiter to help build some of the most critical teams at OpenAI in India across our Go To Market functions. This role is based in Mumbai. This is a high-impact role where you’ll operate as a strategic talent partner not just executing searches, but shaping how we attract, assess, and hire exceptional talent for our teams in India. You’ll own searches end-to-end, working closely with senior stakeholders to define hiring strategies, navigate complex markets, and deliver outstanding outcomes. You’ll report to the APAC recruiting lead and collaborate closely with global recruiting, People, and business leadership to scale our organisation in India in a thoughtful, high-quality way. Your responsibilities Own end-to-end hiring for roles in India, from scoping and calibration through to offer and close. Partner closely with senior business leaders to deeply understand team needs, define hiring strategies, and translate business priorities into actionable talent plans. Build and execute proactive, data-informed sourcing strategies to attract high-calibre and diverse talent across competitive markets. Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, driving alignment, challenging assumptions, and maintaining a consistently high hiring bar. Deliver an exceptional candidate experience, ensuring every interaction reflects OpenAI’s values and mission. Navigate the hiring environment in India by partnering with People, Legal, and Compensation to ensure consistency, fairness, and compliance. Continuously improve recruiting processes, identifying bottlenecks and implementing scalable solutions to increase quality and velocity. Bring market intelligence and insights to stakeholders, influencing hiring decisions and shaping talent strategy. We’re seeking: 5-7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in-house at high-growth or high-bar environments. Proven track record of hiring for business functions (e.g. Sales, Technical Success, RevOps, Partnerships, User Ops). Strong talent judgment, you can assess both experience and potential, and consistently raise the bar. Comfortable operating as a strategic partner, influencing senior stakeholders and navigating ambiguity. Highly execution-oriented, with the ability to run multiple complex searches simultaneously without sacrificing quality. Skilled in building pipelines from scratch, especially in competitive or emerging talent markets. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across regions and cultures. Data-informed and structured in your approach, using insights to guide decisions and improve outcomes. Experience with modern recruiting tools (e.g. Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter) and a mindset for leveraging new technologies. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link . OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

descriptionAr: We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team. You will be the technical authority embedded with our most complex customers, guiding them through deployment, architecture, onboarding, and the adoption of agentic development workflows. You bring deep hands-on experience from prior roles and use that depth to advise, design repeatable patterns, and drive customer outcomes end to end. You operate autonomously, own the technical success of your customers, and bring their experience back to shape how Coder builds and delivers. This is not an execution-only role. You are equally comfortable doing deep technical work with a customer and stepping back to design the repeatable pattern behind it. You are energized by ambiguity, motivated by customer outcomes, and able to influence organizational change alongside the technical work. What you'll do here Serve as the primary technical authority for post-sales customers, guiding deployment architecture, environment design, and adoption of Coder across both human and AI development workflows. Own onboarding engagements end-to-end, ensuring customers move from contract to productive adoption with speed and confidence. Lead engagements where architecture decisions, rollout patterns, or organizational dynamics are limiting customer health or growth. Help customers implement the technical and organizational changes required to adopt agentic development practices at scale. Design and document repeatable delivery patterns across onboarding, architecture, and adoption that can scale across customer segments. Design and recommend reference architectures tailored to each customer's cloud environment, security posture, and organizational constraints. Translate customer environment complexity into clear guidance on networking, ingress, identity, and infrastructure patterns. Anticipate technical and operational risks, escalate to the right internal stakeholders, and track issues through to resolution. Contribute to technical documentation, architecture guides, how-to resources, and statements of work that extend your impact across the customer base. Capture structured product feedback from customer deployments and advocate directly with engineering and product teams for roadmap and usability improvements. What we're looking for 5+ years of experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architect, Platform Engineering, or equivalent post-sales technical role, with a demonstrated track record of guiding enterprise customers through complex technical deployments. Proven hands-on experience from a prior role designing and deploying cloud infrastructure on at least one major provider: AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure; you have done the work and can speak to it with specificity. 2+ years of production experience with Kubernetes: cluster design, workload scheduling, networking, storage, and operational lifecycle. 2+ years of experience with Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tooling; you understand how enterprise teams structure, version, and maintain IaC at scale. Solid understanding of Linux systems administration, including networking fundamentals: ingress controllers, proxies, load balancers, and DNS resolution in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design and DevOps practices; you understand how code moves from commit to running workload in an enterprise context. Working knowledge of cloud security and identity: IAM patterns, network segmentation, secrets management, and compliance-relevant controls. Understanding of observability practices including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems Experience with AI tooling at both the user level (coding agents, assistants) and infrastructure level (model proxies, LLM routing layers such as LiteLLM). Demonstrated ability to design repeatable delivery patterns, not just solve one-off problems. Comfort working through organizational and workflow change alongside technical change with customers. Strong verbal and written communication skills: you can hold a room with a senior infrastructure team and produce a clear architecture document without those being separate skills. High customer empathy: you understand that the best technical solution does not always fit a customer's constraints, timeline, or organizational reality. Self-directed, analytically minded, and comfortable operating with full autonomy in a startup environment. Bonus tacos if you have (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!) Experience at both early-stage startups and larger software organizations. Background as a Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Platform Engineer before moving into a customer-facing role. Familiarity with regulated environments: air-gapped deployments, network isolation, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or DORA requirements. Experience with disaster recovery design and multi-region availability patterns. Cloud cost optimization experience, including rightsizing, reserved capacity, and FinOps practices. Experience with Tailscale or similar overlay networking tools. Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD, or CKS). Open-source contributions. Experience with Backstage.io or similar internal developer portals and platform tooling. Prior work on or alongside a developer platform or platform engineering team. Experience introducing new operating models or delivery patterns across post-sales or go-to-market teams. About Coder Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com . descriptionAr: About the Role ClickHouse is launching a strategic Postgres initiative to extend our developer-first cloud platform, so teams can easily integrate Postgres with ClickHouse and power end-to-end data workflows. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building this platform. You’ll work across a range of areas — from control plane services and automation to operational tooling and developer experience. This is a flexible, full-stack systems role for an engineer who thrives in environments where boundaries are fluid, problems are complex, and impact is tangible. What You’ll Do Design and build backend services that orchestrate and manage database clusters in ClickHouse Cloud. Extend our platform control plane — written in Ruby, Go, and TypeScript — to support new Postgres capabilities. Contribute to PostgreSQL extensions and data plane agents, written in C, C++ or Rust Contribute to automation and tooling that simplify cluster provisioning, scaling, and lifecycle management. Collaborate with infrastructure, SRE, and product teams to ensure operational excellence, performance, and reliability. Develop APIs and integrations that expose new Postgres functionality to customers and internal systems. Improve observability, deployment safety, and debugging workflows for database services. Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and on-call rotations, contributing to the overall reliability and velocity of the team. Operate with autonomy — identifying opportunities, driving execution, and delivering meaningful impact. About You Experience: 6+ years in software engineering, ideally with experience building or operating database or cloud platform systems. Postgres Expertise: Deep understanding of Postgres — configuration, extensions, operations, and performance tuning. Technical Skills: Strong programming experience in one or several of Ruby , Go , Rust, C or Python (and willingness to work across languages). Familiarity with cloud infrastructure , APIs , and automation tools (Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD). Understanding of distributed systems , data replication, and service orchestration patterns. Mindset: Pragmatic, detail-oriented, and comfortable with both greenfield development and operational ownership. Flexibility: Happy to contribute where needed — from backend APIs and platform automation to Postgres internals and debugging. Collaboration: Strong communicator who works effectively across teams in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Ownership: You operate with a founder’s mindset — take initiative, move quickly, and care deeply about outcomes. Why Join Us Be part of a strategic new offering that expands the scope and impact of ClickHouse Cloud. Work with cutting-edge database and infrastructure technologies at scale. Operate with high autonomy in a small, focused team that values deep expertise and collaboration. Shape foundational systems for reliability, automation, and developer experience in managed database. Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Equal Opportunity & Privacy ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. You'll work closely with Cloudflare’s Network Infrastructure planning team, Network Engineering team, Infrastructure automation team, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, Project Managers and with various vendors and partners (including hardware vendors, logistics, datacenter and network providers, and ISPs) to plan and aggressively execute the expansion of our network. You will further be responsible for the development and implementation of consistent processes and tools for consistent and effective management of our infrastructure. This is a highly visible position that requires deep technical understanding of datacenter infrastructure, physical and logical network configuration, system administration, server provisioning and troubleshooting, and basic experience with data analysis and project management. To be successful in this position, you should have excellent technical skills, communication skills, and be able to navigate a range of challenges and constraints (e.g. schedule adherence, time zones, and cultures). You will have the opportunity to (literally) build a faster, safer Internet for our millions of users and the billions of web surfers that visit their sites each month. Perform server administration tasks remotely using IPMI/BMC tools, including server provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting and firmware updates. Perform network configuration tasks to network devices in greenfield deployment and brownfield migration activities. Managing remote contractors to complete datacenter installations and upgrades (rack and stack), including coordinating with hardware manufacturers, datacenter and network providers, logistics partners and other service providers in support of our 700+ growing datacenter locations. Build automation to eliminate repetitive work using Python scripts and templated change management workflows (Python + Jinja-based) that standardize deployment steps. Our team also develops agentic AI tools to reduce admin overhead and handling other operational toil. Planning and implementing network and server installations, including in the areas of facility power (AC/DC), cooling, security/access, rack layout and cable management. Providing technical leadership and guidance to remote contractors and junior team members during deployment activities—walking them through configurations, troubleshooting steps, and quality checks. Creating and maintaining documentation, plans, SOPs, MOPs and runbooks. Collaborating with internal teams (Infrastructure Engineering and Planning, Network Engineering and SRE) on day-to-day operations and project planning. Coordinating installation of cross-connects globally in support of physical network expansion. Assisting with the definition, documentation and implementation of consistent processes and standardization across all regions. Limited travel. Familiarity with day-to-day tasks and projects common in Data Center Operations. Experience with optical transport technologies such as CWDM/DWDM. Configuration management tool experience like Saltstack, Chef, Puppet or Ansible. Knowledge and exposure to Network Protocols, Topologies and Enterprise architecture.  Experience writing network configuration and design documentation. Experience with network and server installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. Experience with remote "lights-out" and out-of-band access to data center resources (IPMI/BMC for remote server administration). descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the role Ramp Stack brings AI to the accounting work that happens after the transaction: reconciliations, prepaids and amortization, fixed assets, payroll entries, accruals, allocations, and variance analysis. Stack prepares reviewable work so the customer's team keeps accounting judgment and approval. As a Stack Account Executive, you'll sell to finance and accounting leaders (Controllers, VPs of Accounting, CFOs) in a new, fast-moving product motion. You'll hear how a team actually closes the books, find the recurring manual step that creates drag, and turn it into a focused proof path and a commercial plan. This is broader than a month-end close pitch: you'll connect Stack to the finance team's goals for cleaner data, fewer handoffs, faster close, and more confidence in reporting. What you'll do Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed contract: discovery, tailored demo or scoped pilot, business case, negotiation, close. Run workflow-level discovery: identify the recurring task, its inputs, the preparer and reviewer, and the cost of keeping it manual. Scope and run pilots against a baseline and a success metric, then convert them into a mutual action plan and a decision. Run a high-ownership, high-velocity motion (10–15 deals a month discussed as the lower band; quota target to confirm). Combine Stack with Ramp's core products where it genuinely improves the data, control, or handoff behind the workflow. Bring field feedback to Product, Marketing, and Enablement while the motion is still being built. What you need Quota-carrying, full-cycle closing experience selling to finance or accounting buyers (years of experience to confirm). Exposure to accounting workflows (for example from Basis, FloQast, NetSuite, or similar reporting, forecasting, or close tools). Comfort with a high-ownership, high-velocity motion in an early product. Proven high agency: you build your own pipeline and process without waiting for a playbook. Ability to discuss close, reconciliation, and reporting workflows credibly with Controllers and CFOs. Daily, practical use of AI in your own work. Nice to have CPA, or an accounting or finance background, even earlier in your career. An accounting-to-sales transition, or relationship-manager experience with sales, negotiation, and upsell or cross-sell. Experience on a NetSuite incubation team or with a reporting or forecasting tool. descriptionAr: How do you reach people who don't want to be marketed to? You lead with value. That's our approach with developers and the platform and security leaders who buy Coder: ads that speak to the problems they're actually solving, like where their AI agents run, who governs them, and how to keep code and data under their control. Coder is defining the AI Operating Layer , and paid media is one of the main ways we take that story to market. As our Paid Media Manager, you'll own the strategy and performance of our always-on programs across LinkedIn, Google Search, YouTube, and newer platforms like ChatGPT ads, aimed at our enterprise and target accounts. The goal is better, not just more: every dollar should reach the right people, tell the right story, and turn into pipeline. You'll direct our paid media agency and give them the Coder context they can't get on their own (ICP, positioning, target accounts, business goals). You're just as comfortable in execution as in strategy. You can audit accounts, fix what's broken, or jump in to launch campaigns, and you know what good looks like down to the platform settings. You'll report to our Demand Generation lead and work closely with product marketing, design, web, marketing ops, ABM, regional marketing, and GTM engineering.
