descriptionAr: ClickHouse is powering the next generation of real-time analytics and AI infrastructure. We recently raised a $400M Series D at a $15B valuation, and we're growing fast: expanding our customer base, scaling our cloud business, and widening our product line through acquisitions and net-new Tier-1 launches into new product categories. We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager, GTM Integration & Launch, to own the commercial side of how those products get to market. An acquired product isn't sellable on day one, and neither is a Tier-1 launch. Someone has to decide who we sell it to first, how it's priced, packaged, quoted and approved, how reps get paid for it, and how we'll know whether it's working. This role bridges product strategy and getting deals closed. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Global Revenue Operations, you'll partner with our NPI program team on every acquisition and Tier-1 launch and own the commercial workstream: GTM strategy, commercial diligence, partnering with Commercial leadership on pricing and approvals, compensation alignment with Sales leadership, and contract migration for acquired customers. You'll also report monthly to leadership on how our emerging products are actually selling. Beyond any single launch, you'll turn commercial integration into a repeatable playbook. This is a senior individual contributor role and the commercial owner for every acquisition and Tier-1 launch. What You'll Be Doing Shape GTM strategy for new and acquired products. Define the motion for newly acquired products (e.g., Langfuse) and net-new Tier-1 launches (e.g., Postgres): who we sell to first and why, how it fits our existing selling motions, and what new roles or coverage it needs. Partner with Sales Leadership and Enablement, and build target account lists from usage signals and account intelligence. Own compensation alignment. Work with Sales Leadership and Comp/Planning so reps are paid in a way that drives the motion we want for each new product. Own monthly GTM reporting. Define how we measure launch performance, report wins, gaps, and what broke to leadership, and feed it back so the next launch goes faster. Run commercial diligence and pre-close planning. Assess the target's pricing model, contract paper, billing stack, metering, and revenue recognition, and land at close with a sequenced commercial integration plan rather than a blank page. Partner on commercial design. Work with Commercial leadership on pricing setup, quoting logic, discount and approval rules, and the controls that govern how the product gets sold. Bring the requirements from the acquired business or new product, and make sure the design supports the GTM motion. Own contract and customer migration. Map the acquired base's entitlements to ClickHouse SKUs, move customers onto ClickHouse paper at renewal, and protect revenue through the transition. Own commercial readiness within the NPI program. Drive Finance, Legal, Sales, and the acquired team to commercial readiness, define commercial acceptance criteria for quote-to-cash, sign off on them in NPI's UAT, and provide commercial readiness as an input to the go/no-go. Build the playbook. Turn each integration into a repeatable commercial path, and find and fix what's manual, slow, or error-prone in the commercial system along the way. What You Bring 10+ years across M&A integration, strategy or deals consulting, corporate development, GTM or business operations, revenue operations, or commercial systems, with a track record of owning the commercial side of launches or acquisitions. Direct M&A integration experience, ideally on the GTM side (sales motion, compensation, quote-to-cash). Direct experience building GTM strategy for a new or unproven product. Experience with usage-based or consumption-based business models. You understand how metering, commits, and overages create dependencies across billing, contracts, revenue recognition, and the commercial system. Working knowledge of the systems a commercial integration depends on: Salesforce and CPQ, financial and billing systems, product rating, and telemetry. You can translate GTM needs into clear requirements for quoting, approval, and control logic. Sales compensation design experience, or direct partnership with Sales/Comp teams on incentive structures. Cross-functional leadership. You drive commercial decisions across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product and present them to senior stakeholders. Partnership with enablement teams to build training programs and measure them against outcome metrics. Strong analytical skills, including SQL, to build target lists, measure pilot results, and report on launch effectiveness. Strong written and verbal communication. Bachelor's degree; quantitative or technical field preferred. MBA a plus. Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. descriptionAr: We are looking for a Senior Partner Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team, focused on building Coder’s partner ecosystem across AMER. This is a new function at Coder, modeled on the Forward Deployed Engineer role pioneered by companies like Palantir and now the fastest-growing technical role at frontier AI companies. You are part Field CTO, part Industry Strategist, part Technical Specialist, and part Partner Relations Lead. You will be the technical authority within our AMER partner ecosystem: setting the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI, cloud, and modernization offerings, co-creating the GTM sales plays that partner sellers take to market, building the demonstrations and workshops that generate pipeline, and producing the Partner Relations content that establishes Coder’s technical brand in the ecosystem. This is not a support role. You are equally comfortable holding a strategic roadmap conversation with a partner CTO and debugging a Kubernetes deployment in a partner’s lab in the same afternoon. You are energized by the challenge of building a new category through partnerships, motivated by the multiplied impact of enabling an entire ecosystem rather than a single customer, and capable of operating with full autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment. Own the technical relationship and set the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI and modernization portfolio. Co-create sales plays tailored to each partner’s customer base, vertical focus, and services capabilities. Author Working Backwards outcome proposals for strategic partner-customer combinations that translate AI Development Infrastructure into deal-level urgency. Codify each successful partner engagement into a repeatable GTM play: trigger conditions, discovery questions, positioning framework, demo script, PoV scope template, and expected outcomes. Build a playbook library that a new PDE or partner seller can pick up and run. Build AI-powered self-service tools that automate high-volume PDE activities: Opportunity Brief Generator, PR/FAQ Generator, Workshop-in-a-Box deployment, and demo site builder. Produce a monthly partner intelligence digest from AMER engagements: what customers are asking for, how competitors are positioning, where integrations are missing, and which vertical use cases are emerging. Distribute to Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership. Own the AMER-relevant portions of the joint technical integration roadmap with strategic partners. Define priorities cross-functionally with Product and Engineering based on field signals from the AMER market. Create and publish Partner Relations content, the ecosystem equivalent of Developer Relations: technical blog posts, cookbooks, partner ecosystem conference talks, enablement videos, and workshop recaps. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. As an Professional Services Consultant for Application Security and Performance, you are an individual contributor working in the post-sales landscape, responsible for the technical execution of solutions and guidance to our customers to get the most value possible from their Cloudflare investment. You are an expert in Layer 7 products like: DDoS Protection, WAF, API Gateway, Bot Management, Certificates Manager, Rate Limiting, SSL and Page Shield. Working experience with security aspects of an internet property, such as Firewalls, WAFs, Bot Management, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS. descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Ramp is hiring a Manager, CSM, New Products to build and lead the team that helps customers put our newest products to work. This team supports customers across segments. Its job is to take a new product from sales handoff through implementation, first useful result, and early adoption, then make sure the next owner has a clear path forward. The products and customer needs will change. You will build a team and an operating rhythm that can change with them. You will coach people with different strengths, help them make good decisions when the playbook is still being written, and turn what we learn from customers into a better way to launch the next one. You will work closely with Sales, core Customer Success, Solutions, Product, and Operations to make the customer experience feel coordinated. What You'll Do Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a growing team of Customer Activation Managers. Set a clear bar for customer judgment, implementation ownership, follow-through, and communication. Give direct, useful feedback through customer-call reviews, case discussions, one-on-ones, and development plans. Help strong individual contributors grow into broader scope and address performance gaps early. Help the team turn an unclear sales handoff into a customer plan with the right stakeholders, prerequisites, owners, milestones, and first useful outcome. Step in on complex launches and escalations when your judgment will move the work forward. Build and improve the team's implementation process: assignment and handoff, customer discovery, launch plans, specialist engagement, first-use checks, adoption follow-up, and the transition to ongoing ownership. Make ownership clear when a customer has both a core Customer Success Manager and a New Products specialist. Keep one customer plan while giving the specialist room to lead the product implementation. Use customer progress, launch quality, team capacity, and time spent on implementations to spot where customers or team members are getting stuck. Adjust coverage and process based on what the data and customer work show. Partner with Sales, Product, Solutions, Support, and Customer Success leaders to resolve recurring blockers, set realistic customer expectations, and improve product readiness and the next launch. Bring early customer patterns back to Product and leadership. Be specific about what customers can do today, what takes specialist help, and what we need to change before the motion scales. Build a team culture where people take ownership, ask for help early, share what they learn, and keep improving the work. What You'll Need Either 2+ years directly managing a customer success, implementation, solutions, or consulting team or 6+ years as an individual contributor in one or more of those roles, with clear evidence that you have coached others and led work beyond your own accounts. A record of taking customers through a complex implementation or workflow change, from discovery and planning to first use and adoption. You know how to tell whether a customer is actually using what was launched. Experience building or improving a process that other people used, with examples of what you changed after seeing it work in practice. Strong coaching judgment. You can diagnose whether someone needs clearer expectations, better skills, more support, or a change in approach, and you can give feedback that improves performance. Comfort making coverage and prioritization decisions with incomplete information. You can balance customer complexity, team capacity, and product readiness without losing sight of the customer's outcome. The ability to work across Sales, Product, Solutions, and Customer Success when ownership is shared or a customer issue has no obvious answer. Clear communication with customers, individual contributors, and senior leaders. You can explain a risk, make a recommendation, and identify the next owner and step. Curiosity about new products and enough technical and finance fluency to ask good questions, challenge a launch plan, and bring in the right expert. You do not need to be the specialist for every product the team supports. Nice to Haves Experience building a new post-sale team or launching an implementation motion before the playbook was mature. Experience supporting both high-touch implementations and lighter-weight activation paths across different customer segments. Experience with finance software, accounting workflows, developer-facing products, or AI-assisted customer workflows. Experience using customer and team data to improve coverage, coaching, and implementation quality. descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Ramp is hiring a Mid-Market Account Based Marketing Manager to extend Enterprise Marketing's proven account-based engine into our Mid-Market segment. You'll partner with Mid-Market AEs to help win our highest-value opportunities by reaching executive buyers, overcoming specific deal obstacles and differentiating Ramp, while building scalable, signal-led patch programs that give SDRs and AEs relevant reasons to engage the right buyers and turn priority accounts into meetings and qualified sales-qualified leads (SQLs). As the Mid-Market AE team continues to scale and grow throughout 2027 and more outbound runs through dedicated priority account programs, this role makes our account engagement more intentional and relevant rather than simply higher volume, leading with the Ramp solutions that best fit each buyer's needs. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role on the Enterprise Marketing team. What You'll Do Partner with Mid-Market AEs on high-value, in-flight opportunities, using tailored outreach and coordinated engagement to reach executive buyers, overcome specific deal obstacles and introduce the Ramp solutions that best fit each buyer's needs, rather than one-size-fits-all product entry Build and run scalable, signal-led patch programs that give SDRs and AEs relevant reasons to engage the right buyers and convert priority accounts into meetings and qualified SQLs Run tiered plays across 1:many cohorts, 1:few groups by industry, buyer or use case, and 1:1 programs for the highest-value opportunities Align priority cohorts with Mid-Market leadership, Enterprise Marketing and RevOps through a monthly prioritization review and weekly async intake Measure impact on incremental contribution profit, account progression, conversion and ACV, including holdout-based lift tests What You Need 4+ years of Account-based marketing experience supporting Mid-Market new business sales Experience building repeatable patch (account-level) programs with sales teams A track record of moving named accounts forward. You can point to specific deals your campaigns helped open or advance and explain how A builder’s mindset. You’ve built an ABM program or taken another experimental channel from zero to one, from designing the first test to deciding what to scale A close partnership with Sales. You’ve joined deal reviews, contributed to account plans, and advocated for your ideas with AEs, Sales leaders, and your own team Hands-on experience with Salesforce, intent data tools like 6sense or Demandbase, gifting platforms, direct mail vendors, and event operations. You pull your own reports and use them to make decisions Sharp creative judgment about what earns a CFO, Controller, or VP of Finance’s attention. You’re willing to run a bold, imperfect play and use what you learn to improve the next one The ability to execute from idea to delivery. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, TX What you'll do We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our WARP Mobile SDK team to help build the future of our mobile security SDKs. Responsibilities In this role, you will define the client architecture and public APIs for native iOS and Android SDKs, working from deep expertise in at least one of those ecosystems. You will establish foundations that are testable, well-documented, lightweight, and straightforward for customer engineering teams to integrate and operate. As a senior software engineer, you will set standards for compatibility, diagnostics, performance, and release quality across mobile platforms. You will work closely with product and engineering partners to turn a security problem into a dependable developer product, mentor native mobile engineers, and help resolve complex customer integration issues. You will be successful in this role if you combine strong native engineering judgment and a track record of carrying distributed software from design through production operation. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience: Deep experience building production software for either iOS with Swift or Android with Kotlin , and enough familiarity with the other ecosystem to guide shared architectural decisions Experience designing or owning customer-distributed SDKs , libraries, or similarly constrained developer-facing products Experience with mobile platform security concepts , including app and device integrity, secure key storage, application signing, authentication, and secure communications Familiarity with native mobile networking stacks , HTTP APIs, and the integration challenges introduced by different application architectures and networking libraries Experience diagnosing production issues that cross application, SDK, network, and service boundaries, while designing safe diagnostics that do not expose sensitive data Understanding of mobile package distribution, source and binary compatibility, dependency management, and reliable release practices Experience writing technical designs and aligning decisions across product, client, backend, edge, and security teams Experience mentoring engineers and raising a team's technical bar through design review, code review, and knowledge sharing Empathetic, proactive, and constructive written and verbal communication skills Proven ability to operate within strict mobile performance budgets, including binary size, battery use, startup time, and main-thread overhead Bonus Points: Familiarity with how native SDKs are consumed by cross-platform frameworks such as React Native and Flutter is a plus Familiarity with lower-level languages like C++ or Rust for high-performance , cross-platform security modules is a plus Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S. Health & Welfare Benefits Medical/Rx Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts Commuter Spending Accounts Fertility & Family Forming Benefits On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program Global Travel Medical Insurance Financial Benefits Short and Long Term Disability Insurance Life & Accident Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Employee Stock Participation Plan Time Off Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenia

descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend  The Opportunity:  Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem. As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana. You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise. AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What You’ll Be Doing: Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability. Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs. Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities. Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands. Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk. Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through. Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work. Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities. Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need. Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work. Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes. Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions. What Makes You a Great Fit Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly. A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers. A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands. Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes. Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation. An appreciation for open-sou
